```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './GamePage.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, getLevelSpeed } from '../utils/gameConstants';
import { 
  createEmptyBoard, 
  getRandomPiece, 
  isValidPosition, 
  placePiece, 
  clearLines, 
  calculateScore,
  getGhostPiece,
  rotatePiece
} from '../utils/gameLogic';
import GameBoard from './GameBoard';
import GameInfo from './GameInfo';
import HoldArea from './HoldArea';
import NextPieces from './NextPieces';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
  }, []);

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const rotated = rotatePiece(currentPiece);
    if (isValidPosition(rotated, board)) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 嘗試移動到最左邊
      for (let testX = 0; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        
        // 如果找到了最左邊的位置，就停止
        if (testX === 0 && bestX === 0) break;
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 嘗試移動到最右邊 - 簡化邏輯
      let foundRightmost = false;
      for (let testX = BOARD_WIDTH - 1; testX >= currentPiece.x; testX--) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          foundRightmost = true;
          break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundRightmost = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (foundRightmost) break;
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    setBoard(clearedBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
      setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
      setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
      
      // 更新等級
      const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
      if (newLevel > level) {
        setLevel(newLevel);
        // 顯示等級升等提示
        setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
        setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
      }
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;

              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;

現在我需要更新GameBoard組件來顯示消除行的特效：


```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './GamePage.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, getLevelSpeed } from '../utils/gameConstants';
import { 
  createEmptyBoard, 
  getRandomPiece, 
  isValidPosition, 
  placePiece, 
  clearLines, 
  calculateScore,
  getGhostPiece,
  rotatePiece
} from '../utils/gameLogic';
import GameBoard from './GameBoard';
import GameInfo from './GameInfo';
import HoldArea from './HoldArea';
import NextPieces from './NextPieces';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
  }, []);

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const rotated = rotatePiece(currentPiece);
    if (isValidPosition(rotated, board)) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 嘗試移動到最左邊
      for (let testX = 0; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        
        // 如果找到了最左邊的位置，就停止
        if (testX === 0 && bestX === 0) break;
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 嘗試移動到最右邊 - 簡化邏輯
      let foundRightmost = false;
      for (let testX = BOARD_WIDTH - 1; testX >= currentPiece.x; testX--) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          foundRightmost = true;
          break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundRightmost = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (foundRightmost) break;
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;

```javascript
import React from 'react';
import './GameBoard.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT } from '../utils/gameConstants';

const GameBoard = ({ board, currentPiece, ghostPiece, clearingLines, isClearing }) => {
  // 渲染方塊
  const renderPiece = (piece, isGhost = false) => {
    if (!piece) return null;

    return piece.shape.map((row, y) =>
      row.map((cell, x) => {
        if (cell) {
          const style = {
            position: 'absolute',
            left: `${(piece.x + x) * 25}px`,
            top: `${(piece.y + y) * 25}px`,
            width: '23px',
            height: '23px',
            backgroundColor: isGhost ? 'transparent' : piece.color,
            border: isGhost ? `2px solid ${piece.color}` : '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)',
            borderRadius: '2px',
            boxShadow: isGhost ? 'none' : 'inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
            zIndex: isGhost ? 1 : 2
          };
          return <div key={`${x}-${y}`} style={style} />;
        }
        return null;
      })
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="game-board">
      <div className="board-grid">
        {board.map((row, y) =>
          row.map((cell, x) => (
            <div
              key={`${x}-${y}`}
              className="grid-cell"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: cell || 'transparent',
                border: cell ? '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)' : '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                boxShadow: cell ? 'inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)' : 'none'
              }}
            />
          ))
        )}
      </div>
      
      {/* 鬼影方塊 */}
      {ghostPiece && renderPiece(ghostPiece, true)}
      
      {/* 當前方塊 */}
      {currentPiece && renderPiece(currentPiece, false)}
    </div>
  );
};

export default GameBoard;

import React from 'react';
import './GameBoard.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT } from '../utils/gameConstants';

const GameBoard = ({ board, currentPiece, ghostPiece, clearingLines, isClearing }) => {
  // 渲染方塊
  const renderPiece = (piece, isGhost = false) => {
    if (!piece) return null;

    return piece.shape.map((row, y) =>
      row.map((cell, x) => {
        if (cell) {
          const style = {
            position: 'absolute',
            left: `${(piece.x + x) * 25}px`,

  );

```css
.game-board {
  position: relative;
  width: 250px;
  height: 500px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
  border: 3px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
}

.board-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(10, 1fr);
  grid-template-rows: repeat(20, 1fr);
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  gap: 1px;
  padding: 1px;
}

.grid-cell {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-radius: 1px;
  transition: all 0.1s ease;
}

.grid-cell:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

/* 消除行特效 */
.clearing-line {
  animation: clearLineEffect 0.5s ease-in-out;
}

@keyframes clearLineEffect {
  0% {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) !important;
    transform: scale(1);
  }
  50% {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 0, 0.9) !important;
    transform: scale(1.1);
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 255, 0, 0.8);
  }
  100% {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) !important;
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

/* 消除特效覆蓋層 */
.clearing-effect {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, 
    rgba(255, 255, 0, 0.8) 0%,
    rgba(255, 165, 0, 0.8) 25%,
    rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.8) 50%,
    rgba(255, 165, 0, 0.8) 75%,
    rgba(255, 255, 0, 0.8) 100%
  );
  animation: clearingWave 0.5s ease-in-out;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 10;
}

@keyframes clearingWave {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scaleX(0);
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scaleX(1);
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255, 255, 0, 0.6);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scaleX(1);
  }
}

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {

  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);

  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);

  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
  }, []);

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const rotated = rotatePiece(currentPiece);
    if (isValidPosition(rotated, board)) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 嘗試移動到最左邊
      for (let testX = 0; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        
        // 如果找到了最左邊的位置，就停止
        if (testX === 0 && bestX === 0) break;
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 嘗試移動到最右邊 - 簡化邏輯
      let foundRightmost = false;
      for (let testX = BOARD_WIDTH - 1; testX >= currentPiece.x; testX--) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          foundRightmost = true;
          break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundRightmost = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (foundRightmost) break;
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './GamePage.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, getLevelSpeed } from '../utils/gameConstants';
import { 
  createEmptyBoard, 
  getRandomPiece, 
  isValidPosition, 
  placePiece, 
  clearLines, 
  calculateScore,
  getGhostPiece,
  rotatePiece
} from '../utils/gameLogic';
import GameBoard from './GameBoard';
import GameInfo from './GameInfo';
import HoldArea from './HoldArea';
import NextPieces from './NextPieces';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
  }, []);

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const rotated = rotatePiece(currentPiece);
    if (isValidPosition(rotated, board)) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 嘗試移動到最左邊
      for (let testX = 0; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        
        // 如果找到了最左邊的位置，就停止
        if (testX === 0 && bestX === 0) break;
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 嘗試移動到最右邊 - 簡化邏輯
      let foundRightmost = false;
      for (let testX = BOARD_WIDTH - 1; testX >= currentPiece.x; testX--) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          foundRightmost = true;
          break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundRightmost = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (foundRightmost) break;
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './GamePage.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, getLevelSpeed } from '../utils/gameConstants';
import { 
  createEmptyBoard, 
  getRandomPiece, 
  isValidPosition, 
  placePiece, 
  clearLines, 
  calculateScore,
  getGhostPiece,
  rotatePiece
} from '../utils/gameLogic';
import GameBoard from './GameBoard';
import GameInfo from './GameInfo';
import HoldArea from './HoldArea';
import NextPieces from './NextPieces';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
  }, []);

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const rotated = rotatePiece(currentPiece);
    if (isValidPosition(rotated, board)) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 嘗試移動到最左邊
      for (let testX = 0; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        
        // 如果找到了最左邊的位置，就停止
        if (testX === 0 && bestX === 0) break;
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 嘗試移動到最右邊 - 簡化邏輯
      let foundRightmost = false;
      for (let testX = BOARD_WIDTH - 1; testX >= currentPiece.x; testX--) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          foundRightmost = true;
          break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundRightmost = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (foundRightmost) break;
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;

```

    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;

```

```markdown
# 背景音樂資料夾

這個資料夾用來存放遊戲的背景音樂和音效文件。

## 建議的音樂文件

### 背景音樂
- `background.mp3` - 主要背景音樂
- `menu.mp3` - 主選單背景音樂
- `game.mp3` - 遊戲進行中的背景音樂

### 音效
- `line_clear.mp3` - 消除行音效
- `rotate.mp3` - 方塊旋轉音效
- `move.mp3` - 方塊移動音效
- `drop.mp3` - 方塊下降音效
- `level_up.mp3` - 等級提升音效
- `game_over.mp3` - 遊戲結束音效

## 文件格式建議

- **音頻格式**: MP3 或 OGG
- **音質**: 128kbps 或以上
- **文件大小**: 建議每個文件不超過 2MB
- **時長**: 背景音樂建議 30秒到 2分鐘循環

## 使用方式

1. 將音樂文件放入此資料夾
2. 在遊戲代碼中使用相對路徑引用：
   ```javascript
   const audio = new Audio('/audio/background.mp3');
   ```

## 注意事項

- 確保音樂文件有適當的使用授權
- 避免使用受版權保護的音樂
- 可以考慮使用免版權音樂或自己創作的音樂
- 音效文件建議使用較短的片段以減少加載時間
```

現在創建一個音效管理的工具文件：


```javascript
// 音效管理器
class AudioManager {
  constructor() {
    this.audioFiles = {
      background: '/audio/background.mp3',
      menu: '/audio/menu.mp3',
      game: '/audio/game.mp3',
      lineClear: '/audio/line_clear.mp3',
      rotate: '/audio/rotate.mp3',
      move: '/audio/move.mp3',
      drop: '/audio/drop.mp3',
      levelUp: '/audio/level_up.mp3',
      gameOver: '/audio/game_over.mp3'
    };
    
    this.audioInstances = {};
    this.isMuted = false;
    this.volume = 0.5;
    
    this.initializeAudio();
  }
  
  // 初始化音頻實例
  initializeAudio() {
    Object.keys(this.audioFiles).forEach(key => {
      try {
        const audio = new Audio(this.audioFiles[key]);
        audio.volume = this.volume;
        audio.preload = 'auto';
        this.audioInstances[key] = audio;
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`無法加載音頻文件: ${this.audioFiles[key]}`, error);
      }
    });
  }
  
  // 播放音效
  playSound(soundKey) {
    if (this.isMuted) return;
    
    const audio = this.audioInstances[soundKey];
    if (audio) {
      try {
        audio.currentTime = 0; // 重設到開始
        audio.play().catch(error => {
          console.warn(`播放音效失敗: ${soundKey}`, error);
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`播放音效時發生錯誤: ${soundKey}`, error);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 播放背景音樂
  playBackgroundMusic(musicKey, loop = true) {
    if (this.isMuted) return;
    
    // 停止其他背景音樂
    Object.keys(this.audioInstances).forEach(key => {
      if (['background', 'menu', 'game'].includes(key) && key !== musicKey) {
        const audio = this.audioInstances[key];
        if (audio) {
          audio.pause();
          audio.currentTime = 0;
        }
      }
    });
    
    const audio = this.audioInstances[musicKey];
    if (audio) {
      try {
        audio.loop = loop;
        audio.volume = this.volume * 0.7; // 背景音樂音量稍低
        audio.play().catch(error => {
          console.warn(`播放背景音樂失敗: ${musicKey}`, error);
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`播放背景音樂時發生錯誤: ${musicKey}`, error);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 停止背景音樂
  stopBackgroundMusic() {
    ['background', 'menu', 'game'].forEach(key => {
      const audio = this.audioInstances[key];
      if (audio) {
        audio.pause();
        audio.currentTime = 0;
      }
    });
  }
  
  // 設置音量
  setVolume(volume) {
    this.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume));
    
    Object.values(this.audioInstances).forEach(audio => {
      if (audio) {
        // 背景音樂音量稍低
        const isBackground = ['background', 'menu', 'game'].includes(
          Object.keys(this.audioInstances).find(key => this.audioInstances[key] === audio)
        );
        audio.volume = this.volume * (isBackground ? 0.7 : 1);
      }
    });
  }
  
  // 靜音/取消靜音
  toggleMute() {
    this.isMuted = !this.isMuted;
    
    if (this.isMuted) {
      this.stopBackgroundMusic();
    }
    
    return this.isMuted;
  }
  
  // 設置靜音狀態
  setMuted(muted) {
    this.isMuted = muted;
    
    if (this.isMuted) {
      this.stopBackgroundMusic();
    }
  }
  
  // 獲取靜音狀態
  getMuted() {
    return this.isMuted;
  }
  
  // 獲取音量
  getVolume() {
    return this.volume;
  }
}

// 創建全局音效管理器實例
const audioManager = new AudioManager();

export default audioManager;
```

# 音效文件建議

## 背景音樂建議
以下是一些適合方塊遊戲的背景音樂建議：

### 免版權音樂資源
1. **Freesound.org** - 大量免版權音效
2. **Zapsplat** - 高質量音效庫
3. **BBC Sound Effects** - BBC提供的免版權音效
4. **YouTube Audio Library** - Google提供的免版權音樂

### 音樂風格建議
- **電子音樂** - 適合現代遊戲風格
- **8位元音樂** - 復古遊戲風格
- **輕音樂** - 輕鬆愉快的遊戲體驗
- **節拍音樂** - 與方塊下降節奏同步

## 音效文件命名規範
建議使用以下命名規範：
- 背景音樂：`bg_` 前綴
- 音效：描述性名稱
- 文件格式：`.mp3` 或 `.ogg`

## 文件大小建議
- 背景音樂：1-3MB
- 音效：50-200KB
- 總音頻文件大小：建議不超過 10MB

## 使用授權
確保所有使用的音樂和音效都有適當的使用授權：
- 免版權 (Royalty-Free)
- Creative Commons
- 自創音樂
- 購買的授權音樂

創建一個音頻設置組件：


```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import './AudioSettings.css';
import audioManager from '../utils/audioManager';

const AudioSettings = ({ onClose }) => {
  const [volume, setVolume] = useState(audioManager.getVolume());
  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(audioManager.getMuted());

  const handleVolumeChange = (e) => {
    const newVolume = parseFloat(e.target.value);
    setVolume(newVolume);
    audioManager.setVolume(newVolume);
  };

  const handleMuteToggle = () => {
    const newMuted = audioManager.toggleMute();
    setIsMuted(newMuted);
  };

  const testSound = (soundType) => {
    switch (soundType) {
      case 'move':
        audioManager.playSound('move');
        break;
      case 'rotate':
        audioManager.playSound('rotate');
        break;
      case 'lineClear':
        audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
        break;
      case 'levelUp':
        audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="audio-settings-overlay">
      <div className="audio-settings">
        <h2>音頻設置</h2>
        
        <div className="setting-group">
          <label>音量</label>
          <div className="volume-control">
            <input
              type="range"
              min="0"
              max="1"
              step="0.1"
              value={volume}
              onChange={handleVolumeChange}
              disabled={isMuted}
            />
            <span>{Math.round(volume * 100)}%</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="setting-group">
          <label>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={isMuted}
              onChange={handleMuteToggle}
            />
            靜音
          </label>
        </div>

        <div className="setting-group">
          <label>測試音效</label>
          <div className="sound-tests">
            <button onClick={() => testSound('move')} disabled={isMuted}>
              移動音效
            </button>
            <button onClick={() => testSound('rotate')} disabled={isMuted}>
              旋轉音效
            </button>
            <button onClick={() => testSound('lineClear')} disabled={isMuted}>
              消除行音效
            </button>
            <button onClick={() => testSound('levelUp')} disabled={isMuted}>
              等級提升音效
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <button className="close-button" onClick={onClose}>
          關閉
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AudioSettings;
```

  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border-radius: 15px;
  padding: 30px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  min-width: 400px;
  color: white;
}

.audio-settings h2 {
  margin: 0 0 25px 0;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 1.8rem;
  text-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
}

.setting-group {
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.setting-group label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.volume-control {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 15px;
}

.volume-control input[type="range"] {
  flex: 1;
  height: 6px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  border-radius: 3px;
  outline: none;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
}

.volume-control input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(45deg, #4CAF50, #45a049);
  border-radius: 50%;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.4);
}

.volume-control input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(45deg, #4CAF50, #45a049);
  border-radius: 50%;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.4);
}

.volume-control span {
  min-width: 40px;
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #4CAF50;
}

.setting-group input[type="checkbox"] {
  margin-right: 10px;
  transform: scale(1.2);
}

.sound-tests {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
}

.sound-tests button {
  padding: 10px 15px;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: bold;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  background: linear-gradient(45deg, #2196F3, #1976D2);
  color: white;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(33, 150, 243, 0.4);
}

.sound-tests button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(33, 150, 243, 0.6);
}

.sound-tests button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  transform: none;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.close-button {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 12px 20px;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: bold;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  background: linear-gradient(45deg, #FF6B6B, #FF8E53);
  color: white;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.4);
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.close-button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.6);
}

```markdown
# 方塊堆疊益智遊戲

一個使用React製作的經典方塊堆疊益智遊戲（類似俄羅斯方塊）。

## 功能特色

- 🎮 經典的方塊堆疊遊戲玩法
- 🎨 美觀的UI設計與動畫效果
- 🌄 美麗的自然風景背景
- 📊 完整的計分和等級系統
- 🔄 HOLD功能（暫存方塊）
- 👁️ 預覽下一個方塊
- 👻 鬼影方塊顯示落點
- ⌨️ 完整的鍵盤控制

## 遊戲控制

- **← →** : 左右移動方塊
- **↓** : 快速下降
- **↑** : 旋轉方塊
- **Space** : 瞬間下降到底部
- **Shift** : 暫存當前方塊
- **ESC** : 暫停/繼續遊戲

## 如何開始

1. 安裝依賴：
```bash
npm install
```

2. 啟動開發服務器：
```bash
npm start
```

3. 在瀏覽器中打開 http://localhost:3000

4. 點擊"START"開始遊戲！

## 遊戲規則

- 移動和旋轉下落的方塊，填滿整行來消除
- 消除的行數越多，分數越高
- 隨著等級提升，方塊下降速度會加快
- 使用HOLD功能可以暫存當前方塊，但每放置一個方塊只能使用一次
- 當方塊堆疊到頂部時遊戲結束

## 技術特色

- 使用React Hooks進行狀態管理
- 模組化的組件設計
- 響應式UI設計
- 流暢的動畫效果
- 完整的遊戲邏輯實現
- 音效管理系統
- 消除行特效動畫

## 音頻功能

遊戲支援背景音樂和音效：

### 音頻文件位置
將音頻文件放在 `public/audio/` 資料夾中：

- `background.mp3` - 背景音樂
- `line_clear.mp3` - 消除行音效
- `rotate.mp3` - 旋轉音效
- `move.mp3` - 移動音效
- `level_up.mp3` - 等級提升音效

### 音頻設置
- 音量控制
- 靜音功能
- 音效測試
- 自動循環播放

### 免版權音樂資源
- [Freesound.org](https://freesound.org/)
- [YouTube Audio Library](https://studio.youtube.com/channel/UC/music)
- [BBC Sound Effects](https://sound-effects.bbcrewind.co.uk/)

享受遊戲吧！🎉🎵

```

## �� 創建的資料夾結構

```
public/
└── audio/                    # 音頻文件資料夾
    ├── README.md            # 音頻使用說明
    └── example-sounds.txt   # 音效建議和資源
```

## 🎵 音效管理系統

### 📂 文件結構
- **`public/audio/`** - 存放所有音頻文件
- **`src/utils/audioManager.js`** - 音效管理器
- **`src/components/AudioSettings.js`** - 音頻設置組件

### 🎮 支援的音效類型
- **背景音樂**: `background.mp3`, `menu.mp3`, `game.mp3`
- **遊戲音效**: `line_clear.mp3`, `rotate.mp3`, `move.mp3`, `drop.mp3`
- **特殊音效**: `level_up.mp3`, `game_over.mp3`

### ⚙️ 音效管理功能
- ✅ **音量控制** - 0-100% 音量調節
- ✅ **靜音功能** - 一鍵靜音/取消靜音
- ✅ **自動循環** - 背景音樂自動循環播放
- ✅ **音效測試** - 在設置中測試各種音效
- ✅ **錯誤處理** - 音頻文件缺失時的優雅處理

### 📋 使用方式

**1. 添加音頻文件：**
```bash
# 將你的音頻文件放入
public/audio/background.mp3
public/audio/line_clear.mp3
# 等等...
```

**2. 在遊戲中使用：**
```javascript
import audioManager from '../utils/audioManager';

// 播放背景音樂
audioManager.playBackgroundMusic('background');

// 播放音效
audioManager.playSound('lineClear');

// 設置音量
audioManager.setVolume(0.7);
```

### �� 免版權音樂資源
我已經在README中提供了幾個免版權音樂資源：
- **Freesound.org** - 大量免版權音效
- **YouTube Audio Library** - Google提供的免版權音樂
- **BBC Sound Effects** - BBC提供的免版權音效

### 📝 注意事項
- `.gitignore` 中音頻文件是可選忽略的（目前是註釋狀態）
- 如果音頻文件很大，可以取消註釋來忽略它們
- 確保使用的音樂有適當的使用授權
- 建議音效文件大小控制在 50-200KB
- 背景音樂建議控制在 1-3MB
