現在更新placePieceOnBoard函數中的：


```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './GamePage.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, getLevelSpeed } from '../utils/gameConstants';
import audioManager from '../utils/audioManager';
import { 
  createEmptyBoard, 
  getRandomPiece, 
  isValidPosition, 
  placePiece, 
  clearLines, 
  calculateScore,
  getGhostPiece,
  rotatePiece
} from '../utils/gameLogic';
import GameBoard from './GameBoard';
import GameInfo from './GameInfo';
import HoldArea from './HoldArea';
import NextPieces from './NextPieces';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);
  const [currentMusic, setCurrentMusic] = useState(null);

  // 根據等級選擇背景音樂
  const selectBackgroundMusic = useCallback((level) => {
    let musicKey;
    if (level >= 5) {
      musicKey = 'game2';
    } else {
      musicKey = 'game1';
    }
    
    if (musicKey !== currentMusic) {
      audioManager.playBackgroundMusic(musicKey);
      setCurrentMusic(musicKey);
    }
  }, [currentMusic]);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
    setCurrentMusic(null);
    
    // 開始播放遊戲背景音樂
    selectBackgroundMusic(0);
  }, [selectBackgroundMusic]);

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const rotated = rotatePiece(currentPiece);
    if (isValidPosition(rotated, board)) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 嘗試移動到最左邊
      for (let testX = 0; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        
        // 如果找到了最左邊的位置，就停止
        if (testX === 0 && bestX === 0) break;
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 嘗試移動到最右邊 - 簡化邏輯
      let foundRightmost = false;
      for (let testX = BOARD_WIDTH - 1; testX >= currentPiece.x; testX--) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          foundRightmost = true;
          break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundRightmost = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (foundRightmost) break;
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

```javascript
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundRightmost = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (foundRightmost) break;
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;

```

現在添加一個清理函數，當遊戲結束時停止背景音樂：


```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './GamePage.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, getLevelSpeed } from '../utils/gameConstants';
import audioManager from '../utils/audioManager';
import { 
  createEmptyBoard, 
  getRandomPiece, 
  isValidPosition, 
  placePiece, 
  clearLines, 
  calculateScore,
  getGhostPiece,
  rotatePiece
} from '../utils/gameLogic';
import GameBoard from './GameBoard';
import GameInfo from './GameInfo';
import HoldArea from './HoldArea';
import NextPieces from './NextPieces';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);
  const [currentMusic, setCurrentMusic] = useState(null);

  // 根據等級選擇背景音樂
  const selectBackgroundMusic = useCallback((level) => {
    let musicKey;
    if (level >= 5) {
      musicKey = 'game2';
    } else {
      musicKey = 'game1';
    }
    
    if (musicKey !== currentMusic) {
      audioManager.playBackgroundMusic(musicKey);
      setCurrentMusic(musicKey);
    }
  }, [currentMusic]);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
    setCurrentMusic(null);
    
    // 開始播放遊戲背景音樂
    selectBackgroundMusic(0);
  }, [selectBackgroundMusic]);

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const rotated = rotatePiece(currentPiece);
    if (isValidPosition(rotated, board)) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 嘗試移動到最左邊
      for (let testX = 0; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        
        // 如果找到了最左邊的位置，就停止
        if (testX === 0 && bestX === 0) break;
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 嘗試移動到最右邊 - 簡化邏輯
      let foundRightmost = false;
      for (let testX = BOARD_WIDTH - 1; testX >= currentPiece.x; testX--) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          foundRightmost = true;
          break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundRightmost = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (foundRightmost) break;
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  // 遊戲結束時清理音效
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gameOver) {
      // 停止背景音樂
      audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
    }
  }, [gameOver]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;
```

現在添加一些遊戲中的音效：


```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './GamePage.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, getLevelSpeed } from '../utils/gameConstants';
import audioManager from '../utils/audioManager';
import { 
  createEmptyBoard, 
  getRandomPiece, 
  isValidPosition, 
  placePiece, 
  clearLines, 
  calculateScore,
  getGhostPiece,
  rotatePiece
} from '../utils/gameLogic';
import GameBoard from './GameBoard';
import GameInfo from './GameInfo';
import HoldArea from './HoldArea';
import NextPieces from './NextPieces';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);
  const [currentMusic, setCurrentMusic] = useState(null);

  // 根據等級選擇背景音樂
  const selectBackgroundMusic = useCallback((level) => {
    let musicKey;
    if (level >= 5) {
      musicKey = 'game2';
    } else {
      musicKey = 'game1';
    }
    
    if (musicKey !== currentMusic) {
      audioManager.playBackgroundMusic(musicKey);
      setCurrentMusic(musicKey);
    }
  }, [currentMusic]);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
    setCurrentMusic(null);
    
    // 開始播放遊戲背景音樂
    selectBackgroundMusic(0);
  }, [selectBackgroundMusic]);

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const rotated = rotatePiece(currentPiece);
    if (isValidPosition(rotated, board)) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
      // 播放旋轉音效
      audioManager.playSound('rotate');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 嘗試移動到最左邊
      for (let testX = 0; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        
        // 如果找到了最左邊的位置，就停止
        if (testX === 0 && bestX === 0) break;
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 嘗試移動到最右邊 - 簡化邏輯
      let foundRightmost = false;
      for (let testX = BOARD_WIDTH - 1; testX >= currentPiece.x; testX--) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          foundRightmost = true;
          break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundRightmost = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (foundRightmost) break;
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  // 遊戲結束時清理音效
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gameOver) {
      // 停止背景音樂
      audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
    }
  }, [gameOver]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;
```

```javascript
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',

      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);

        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  // 遊戲結束時清理音效
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gameOver) {
      // 停止背景音樂
      audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
    }
  }, [gameOver]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;
```

## 🎵 背景音樂系統完成

### 📁 音樂文件配置
根據你的README設置，現在支援：
- **`menu.mp3`** - 選單背景音樂 (Disfigure - Blank)
- **`game1.mp3`** - Level 1-4 遊戲音樂 (Amadeus - Legendary)
- **`game2.mp3`** - Level 5+ 遊戲音樂 ([Nightcore] Mortals)

### �� 音樂播放邏輯
**選單音樂：**
- ✅ 在首頁和按鍵介紹頁面播放 `menu.mp3`
- ✅ 離開選單時自動停止音樂

**遊戲音樂：**
- ✅ **Level 0-4**: 播放 `game1.mp3`
- ✅ **Level 5+**: 播放 `game2.mp3`
- ✅ **自動切換**: 等級提升時自動切換音樂
- ✅ **循環播放**: 所有背景音樂都會循環播放

### �� 音效系統
**遊戲音效：**
- ✅ **旋轉音效** - 方塊旋轉時播放
- ✅ **消除行音效** - 消除行時播放
- ✅ **等級提升音效** - 升等時播放
- ✅ **遊戲結束音效** - 遊戲結束時播放

### ��️ 音樂控制
**右上角音樂開關：**
- ✅ **固定位置** - 右上角浮動按鈕
- ✅ **視覺反饋** - 靜音時顯示🔇，正常時顯示��
- ✅ **一鍵切換** - 點擊即可開關音樂
- ✅ **狀態同步** - 與音效管理器狀態同步

### ⚙️ 技術特色
**智能音樂管理：**
- ✅ **自動切換** - 根據等級自動選擇合適的音樂
- ✅ **無縫播放** - 切換音樂時不會中斷
- ✅ **循環播放** - 背景音樂自動循環
- ✅ **音量控制** - 背景音樂音量稍低於音效
- ✅ **錯誤處理** - 音頻文件缺失時的優雅處理

### �� 使用方式
1. **添加音樂文件** - 將你的音樂文件放入 `public/audio/` 資料夾
2. **自動播放** - 遊戲會根據當前狀態自動播放合適的音樂
3. **手動控制** - 點擊右上角的音樂開關來控制音樂
4. **等級切換** - 當達到Level 5時，音樂會自動切換到更激烈的版本

現在我需要在音效管理器中添加一個方法來檢查是否正在播放選單音樂：


```javascript
// 音效管理器
class AudioManager {
  constructor() {
    this.audioFiles = {
      menu: '/audio/menu.mp3',
      game1: '/audio/game1.mp3',
      game2: '/audio/game2.mp3',
      lineClear: '/audio/line_clear.mp3',
      rotate: '/audio/rotate.mp3',
      move: '/audio/move.mp3',
      drop: '/audio/drop.mp3',
      levelUp: '/audio/level_up.mp3',
      gameOver: '/audio/game_over.mp3'
    };
    
    this.audioInstances = {};
    this.isMuted = false;
    this.volume = 0.5;
    this.currentBackgroundMusic = null;
    
    this.initializeAudio();
  }
  
  // 初始化音頻實例
  initializeAudio() {
    Object.keys(this.audioFiles).forEach(key => {
      try {
        const audio = new Audio(this.audioFiles[key]);
        audio.volume = this.volume;
        audio.preload = 'auto';
        this.audioInstances[key] = audio;
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`無法加載音頻文件: ${this.audioFiles[key]}`, error);
      }
    });
  }
  
  // 播放音效
  playSound(soundKey) {
    if (this.isMuted) return;
    
    const audio = this.audioInstances[soundKey];
    if (audio) {
      try {
        audio.currentTime = 0; // 重設到開始
        audio.play().catch(error => {
          console.warn(`播放音效失敗: ${soundKey}`, error);
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`播放音效時發生錯誤: ${soundKey}`, error);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 播放背景音樂
  playBackgroundMusic(musicKey, loop = true) {
    if (this.isMuted) return;
    
    // 停止其他背景音樂
    Object.keys(this.audioInstances).forEach(key => {
      if (['menu', 'game1', 'game2'].includes(key) && key !== musicKey) {
        const audio = this.audioInstances[key];
        if (audio) {
          audio.pause();
          audio.currentTime = 0;
        }
      }
    });
    
    const audio = this.audioInstances[musicKey];
    if (audio) {
      try {
        audio.loop = loop;
        audio.volume = this.volume * 0.7; // 背景音樂音量稍低
        audio.play().catch(error => {
          console.warn(`播放背景音樂失敗: ${musicKey}`, error);
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`播放背景音樂時發生錯誤: ${musicKey}`, error);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 停止背景音樂
  stopBackgroundMusic() {
    ['menu', 'game1', 'game2'].forEach(key => {
      const audio = this.audioInstances[key];
      if (audio) {
        audio.pause();
        audio.currentTime = 0;
      }
    });
  }
  
  // 設置音量
  setVolume(volume) {
    this.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume));
    
    Object.values(this.audioInstances).forEach(audio => {
      if (audio) {
        // 背景音樂音量稍低
        const isBackground = ['menu', 'game1', 'game2'].includes(
          Object.keys(this.audioInstances).find(key => this.audioInstances[key] === audio)
        );
        audio.volume = this.volume * (isBackground ? 0.7 : 1);
      }
    });
  }
  
  // 靜音/取消靜音
  toggleMute() {
    this.isMuted = !this.isMuted;
    
    if (this.isMuted) {
      this.stopBackgroundMusic();
    }
    
    return this.isMuted;
  }
  
  // 設置靜音狀態
  setMuted(muted) {
    this.isMuted = muted;
    
    if (this.isMuted) {
      this.stopBackgroundMusic();
    }
  }
  
  // 獲取靜音狀態
  getMuted() {
    return this.isMuted;
  }
  
  // 獲取音量
  getVolume() {
    return this.volume;
  }
}

// 創建全局音效管理器實例
const audioManager = new AudioManager();

export default audioManager;
```

```javascript
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`播放音效時發生錯誤: ${soundKey}`, error);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 播放背景音樂
  playBackgroundMusic(musicKey, loop = true) {
    if (this.isMuted) return;
    
    // 如果正在播放相同的音樂，不要重新開始
    if (this.currentBackgroundMusic === musicKey) {
      const audio = this.audioInstances[musicKey];
      if (audio && !audio.paused) {
        return; // 音樂正在播放，不需要重新開始
      }
    }
    
    // 停止其他背景音樂
    Object.keys(this.audioInstances).forEach(key => {
      if (['menu', 'game1', 'game2'].includes(key) && key !== musicKey) {
        const audio = this.audioInstances[key];
        if (audio) {
          audio.pause();
          audio.currentTime = 0;
        }
      }
    });
    
    const audio = this.audioInstances[musicKey];
    if (audio) {
      try {
        audio.loop = loop;
        audio.volume = this.volume * 0.7; // 背景音樂音量稍低
        this.currentBackgroundMusic = musicKey;
        audio.play().catch(error => {
          console.warn(`播放背景音樂失敗: ${musicKey}`, error);
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`播放背景音樂時發生錯誤: ${musicKey}`, error);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 停止背景音樂
  stopBackgroundMusic() {
    ['menu', 'game1', 'game2'].forEach(key => {
      const audio = this.audioInstances[key];
      if (audio) {
        audio.pause();
        audio.currentTime = 0;
      }
    });
  }
  
  // 設置音量
  setVolume(volume) {
    this.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume));
    
    Object.values(this.audioInstances).forEach(audio => {
      if (audio) {
        // 背景音樂音量稍低
        const isBackground = ['menu', 'game1', 'game2'].includes(
          Object.keys(this.audioInstances).find(key => this.audioInstances[key] === audio)
        );
        audio.volume = this.volume * (isBackground ? 0.7 : 1);
      }
    });
  }
  
  // 靜音/取消靜音
  toggleMute() {
    this.isMuted = !this.isMuted;
    
    if (this.isMuted) {
      this.stopBackgroundMusic();
    }
    
    return this.isMuted;
  }
  
  // 設置靜音狀態
  setMuted(muted) {
    this.isMuted = muted;
    
    if (this.isMuted) {
      this.stopBackgroundMusic();
    }
  }
  
  // 獲取靜音狀態
  getMuted() {
    return this.isMuted;
  }
  
  // 獲取音量
  getVolume() {
    return this.volume;
  }
}
```

```javascript
// 音效管理器
class AudioManager {
  constructor() {
    this.audioFiles = {
      menu: '/audio/menu.mp3',
      game1: '/audio/game1.mp3',
      game2: '/audio/game2.mp3',
      lineClear: '/audio/line_clear.mp3',
      rotate: '/audio/rotate.mp3',
      move: '/audio/move.mp3',
      drop: '/audio/drop.mp3',
      levelUp: '/audio/level_up.mp3',
      gameOver: '/audio/game_over.mp3'
    };
    
    this.audioInstances = {};
    this.isMuted = false;
    this.volume = 0.5;
    this.currentBackgroundMusic = null;
    
    this.initializeAudio();
  }
  
  // 初始化音頻實例
  initializeAudio() {
    Object.keys(this.audioFiles).forEach(key => {
      try {
        const audio = new Audio(this.audioFiles[key]);
        audio.volume = this.volume;
        audio.preload = 'auto';
        this.audioInstances[key] = audio;
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`無法加載音頻文件: ${this.audioFiles[key]}`, error);
      }
    });
  }
  
  // 播放音效
  playSound(soundKey) {
    if (this.isMuted) return;
    
    const audio = this.audioInstances[soundKey];
    if (audio) {
      try {
        audio.currentTime = 0; // 重設到開始
        audio.play().catch(error => {
          console.warn(`播放音效失敗: ${soundKey}`, error);
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`播放音效時發生錯誤: ${soundKey}`, error);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 播放背景音樂
  playBackgroundMusic(musicKey, loop = true) {
    if (this.isMuted) return;
    
    // 如果正在播放相同的音樂，不要重新開始
    if (this.currentBackgroundMusic === musicKey) {
      const audio = this.audioInstances[musicKey];
      if (audio && !audio.paused) {
        return; // 音樂正在播放，不需要重新開始
      }
    }
    
    // 停止其他背景音樂
    Object.keys(this.audioInstances).forEach(key => {
      if (['menu', 'game1', 'game2'].includes(key) && key !== musicKey) {
        const audio = this.audioInstances[key];
        if (audio) {
          audio.pause();
          audio.currentTime = 0;
        }
      }
    });
    
    const audio = this.audioInstances[musicKey];
    if (audio) {
      try {
        audio.loop = loop;
        audio.volume = this.volume * 0.7; // 背景音樂音量稍低
        this.currentBackgroundMusic = musicKey;
        audio.play().catch(error => {
          console.warn(`播放背景音樂失敗: ${musicKey}`, error);
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`播放背景音樂時發生錯誤: ${musicKey}`, error);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 停止背景音樂
  stopBackgroundMusic() {
    ['menu', 'game1', 'game2'].forEach(key => {
      const audio = this.audioInstances[key];
      if (audio) {
        audio.pause();
        audio.currentTime = 0;
      }
    });
    this.currentBackgroundMusic = null;
  }
  
  // 設置音量
  setVolume(volume) {
    this.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume));
    
    Object.values(this.audioInstances).forEach(audio => {
      if (audio) {
        // 背景音樂音量稍低
        const isBackground = ['menu', 'game1', 'game2'].includes(
          Object.keys(this.audioInstances).find(key => this.audioInstances[key] === audio)
        );
        audio.volume = this.volume * (isBackground ? 0.7 : 1);
      }
    });
  }
  
  // 靜音/取消靜音
  toggleMute() {
    this.isMuted = !this.isMuted;
    
    if (this.isMuted) {
      this.stopBackgroundMusic();
    }
    
    return this.isMuted;
  }
  
  // 設置靜音狀態
  setMuted(muted) {
    this.isMuted = muted;
    
    if (this.isMuted) {
      this.stopBackgroundMusic();
    }
  }
  
  // 獲取靜音狀態
  getMuted() {
    return this.isMuted;
  }
  
  // 獲取音量
  getVolume() {
    return this.volume;
  }
}
```
