問題在於moveToEdge的邏輯。對於I形方塊（4格直線），我們需要確保它能移動到真正的最左邊（X=0）。讓我重寫這個函數：


```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './GamePage.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, getLevelSpeed } from '../utils/gameConstants';
import audioManager from '../utils/audioManager';
import { 
  createEmptyBoard, 
  getRandomPiece, 
  isValidPosition, 
  placePiece, 
  clearLines, 
  calculateScore,
  getGhostPiece,
  rotatePiece
} from '../utils/gameLogic';
import GameBoard from './GameBoard';
import GameInfo from './GameInfo';
import HoldArea from './HoldArea';
import NextPieces from './NextPieces';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);
  const [currentMusic, setCurrentMusic] = useState(null);

  // 根據等級選擇背景音樂
  const selectBackgroundMusic = useCallback((level) => {
    let musicKey;
    if (level >= 5) {
      musicKey = 'game2';
    } else {
      musicKey = 'game1';
    }
    
    if (musicKey !== currentMusic) {
      audioManager.playBackgroundMusic(musicKey);
      setCurrentMusic(musicKey);
    }
  }, [currentMusic]);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
    setCurrentMusic(null);
    
    // 開始播放遊戲背景音樂
    selectBackgroundMusic(0);
  }, [selectBackgroundMusic]);

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const rotated = rotatePiece(currentPiece);
    if (isValidPosition(rotated, board)) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
      // 播放旋轉音效
      audioManager.playSound('rotate');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 從最左邊開始測試，找到最左邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = 0; testX <= currentPiece.x; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
          if (testX === 0) break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
              if (testX === 0) break;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (testX === 0 && foundValidPosition) break;
        }
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 從最右邊開始測試，找到最右邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = BOARD_WIDTH - 1; testX >= currentPiece.x; testX--) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          // 如果能在最右邊放置，就使用最右邊
          if (testX === BOARD_WIDTH - 1) break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              // 如果能在最右邊放置，就使用最右邊
              if (testX === BOARD_WIDTH - 1) break;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (testX === BOARD_WIDTH - 1 && foundValidPosition) break;
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  // 遊戲結束時清理音效
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gameOver) {
      // 停止遊戲音樂，但保留選單音樂的記錄
      audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
      // 設置選單音樂為下次播放的音樂
      audioManager.lastPlayedMusic = 'menu';
    }
  }, [gameOver]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;

```

讓我先檢查當前的旋轉邏輯和方塊定義：


現在讓我檢查方塊的定義，特別是I形方塊：


現在讓我檢查當前的旋轉邏輯：


我發現問題了！當前的旋轉邏輯很簡單，只是檢查旋轉後的位置是否有效，如果無效就直接拒絕旋轉。我需要實現一個更智能的旋轉系統，當旋轉會導致方塊超出邊界時，自動調整位置。

讓我創建一個新的旋轉函數，包含牆踢（wall kick）邏輯：


```javascript
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, TETRIS_PIECES, PIECE_TYPES, SCORE_VALUES } from './gameConstants';

// 創建空的遊戲板
export const createEmptyBoard = () => {
  return Array(BOARD_HEIGHT).fill().map(() => Array(BOARD_WIDTH).fill(0));
};

// 隨機生成方塊
export const getRandomPiece = () => {
  const type = PIECE_TYPES[Math.floor(Math.random() * PIECE_TYPES.length)];
  return {
    type,
    shape: TETRIS_PIECES[type].shape,
    color: TETRIS_PIECES[type].color,
    x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(TETRIS_PIECES[type].shape[0].length / 2),
    y: 0
  };
};

// 旋轉方塊
export const rotatePiece = (piece) => {
  const rotated = piece.shape[0].map((_, index) =>
    piece.shape.map(row => row[index]).reverse()
  );
  return {
    ...piece,
    shape: rotated
  };
};

// 智能旋轉方塊（包含牆踢邏輯）
export const rotatePieceWithWallKick = (piece, board) => {
  const rotated = rotatePiece(piece);
  
  // 如果旋轉後位置有效，直接返回
  if (isValidPosition(rotated, board)) {
    return rotated;
  }
  
  // 嘗試牆踢：向左移動1格
  const kickLeft = { ...rotated, x: rotated.x - 1 };
  if (isValidPosition(kickLeft, board)) {
    return kickLeft;
  }
  
  // 嘗試牆踢：向右移動1格
  const kickRight = { ...rotated, x: rotated.x + 1 };
  if (isValidPosition(kickRight, board)) {
    return kickRight;
  }
  
  // 嘗試牆踢：向左移動2格
  const kickLeft2 = { ...rotated, x: rotated.x - 2 };
  if (isValidPosition(kickLeft2, board)) {
    return kickLeft2;
  }
  
  // 嘗試牆踢：向右移動2格
  const kickRight2 = { ...rotated, x: rotated.x + 2 };
  if (isValidPosition(kickRight2, board)) {
    return kickRight2;
  }
  
  // 特殊處理I形方塊：更積極的牆踢
  if (piece.type === 'I') {
    // I形方塊從水平變垂直時，需要更大的調整
    const kickLeft3 = { ...rotated, x: rotated.x - 3 };
    if (isValidPosition(kickLeft3, board)) {
      return kickLeft3;
    }
    
    const kickRight3 = { ...rotated, x: rotated.x + 3 };
    if (isValidPosition(kickRight3, board)) {
      return kickRight3;
    }
  }
  
  // 如果所有牆踢都失敗，返回null表示無法旋轉
  return null;
};

// 檢查方塊是否可以放置在指定位置
export const isValidPosition = (piece, board, dx = 0, dy = 0) => {
  const newX = piece.x + dx;
  const newY = piece.y + dy;

  for (let y = 0; y < piece.shape.length; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < piece.shape[y].length; x++) {
      if (piece.shape[y][x]) {
        const boardX = newX + x;
        const boardY = newY + y;

        // 檢查邊界
        if (boardX < 0 || boardX >= BOARD_WIDTH || boardY >= BOARD_HEIGHT) {
          return false;
        }

        // 檢查是否與已放置的方塊重疊
        if (boardY >= 0 && board[boardY][boardX]) {
          return false;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return true;
};

// 將方塊放置到遊戲板上
export const placePiece = (piece, board) => {
  const newBoard = board.map(row => [...row]);
  
  for (let y = 0; y < piece.shape.length; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < piece.shape[y].length; x++) {
      if (piece.shape[y][x]) {
        const boardX = piece.x + x;
        const boardY = piece.y + y;
        if (boardY >= 0 && boardY < BOARD_HEIGHT && boardX >= 0 && boardX < BOARD_WIDTH) {
          newBoard[boardY][boardX] = piece.color;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return newBoard;
};

// 檢查並清除完整的行
export const clearLines = (board) => {
  const linesToClear = [];
  const newBoard = [];
  
  // 找出需要清除的行
  for (let y = 0; y < board.length; y++) {
    if (board[y].every(cell => cell !== 0)) {
      linesToClear.push(y);
    } else {
      newBoard.push([...board[y]]);
    }
  }
  
  // 在頂部添加空行
  while (newBoard.length < BOARD_HEIGHT) {
    newBoard.unshift(Array(BOARD_WIDTH).fill(0));
  }
  
  return {
    board: newBoard,
    linesCleared: linesToClear.length,
    linesToClear
  };
};

// 計算分數
export const calculateScore = (linesCleared, level) => {
  if (linesCleared === 0) return 0;
  
  let baseScore = 0;
  switch (linesCleared) {
    case 1: baseScore = SCORE_VALUES.SINGLE; break;
    case 2: baseScore = SCORE_VALUES.DOUBLE; break;
    case 3: baseScore = SCORE_VALUES.TRIPLE; break;
    case 4: baseScore = SCORE_VALUES.TETRIS; break;
    default: baseScore = linesCleared * SCORE_VALUES.SINGLE;
  }
  
  return baseScore * (level + 1);
};

// 獲取鬼影方塊位置
export const getGhostPiece = (piece, board) => {
  let ghostY = piece.y;
  
  while (isValidPosition({ ...piece, y: ghostY + 1 }, board)) {
    ghostY++;
  }
  
  return {
    ...piece,
    y: ghostY,
    isGhost: true
  };
};
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './GamePage.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, getLevelSpeed } from '../utils/gameConstants';
import audioManager from '../utils/audioManager';
import { 
  createEmptyBoard, 
  getRandomPiece, 
  isValidPosition, 
  placePiece, 
  clearLines, 
  calculateScore,
  getGhostPiece,
  rotatePiece,
  rotatePieceWithWallKick
} from '../utils/gameLogic';
import GameBoard from './GameBoard';
import GameInfo from './GameInfo';
import HoldArea from './HoldArea';
import NextPieces from './NextPieces';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);
  const [currentMusic, setCurrentMusic] = useState(null);

  // 根據等級選擇背景音樂
  const selectBackgroundMusic = useCallback((level) => {
    let musicKey;
    if (level >= 5) {
      musicKey = 'game2';
    } else {
      musicKey = 'game1';
    }
    
    if (musicKey !== currentMusic) {
      audioManager.playBackgroundMusic(musicKey);
      setCurrentMusic(musicKey);
    }
  }, [currentMusic]);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
    setCurrentMusic(null);
    
    // 開始播放遊戲背景音樂
    selectBackgroundMusic(0);
  }, [selectBackgroundMusic]);

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const rotated = rotatePiece(currentPiece);
    if (isValidPosition(rotated, board)) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
      // 播放旋轉音效
      audioManager.playSound('rotate');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 從最左邊開始測試，找到最左邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = 0; testX <= currentPiece.x; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
          if (testX === 0) break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
              if (testX === 0) break;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (testX === 0 && foundValidPosition) break;
        }
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 從最右邊開始測試，找到最右邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = BOARD_WIDTH - 1; testX >= currentPiece.x; testX--) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          // 如果能在最右邊放置，就使用最右邊
          if (testX === BOARD_WIDTH - 1) break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              // 如果能在最右邊放置，就使用最右邊
              if (testX === BOARD_WIDTH - 1) break;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (testX === BOARD_WIDTH - 1 && foundValidPosition) break;
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  // 遊戲結束時清理音效
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gameOver) {
      // 停止遊戲音樂，但保留選單音樂的記錄
      audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
      // 設置選單音樂為下次播放的音樂
      audioManager.lastPlayedMusic = 'menu';
    }
  }, [gameOver]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;
```

```javascript
      // 從最右邊開始測試，找到最右邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = BOARD_WIDTH - 1; testX >= currentPiece.x; testX--) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          // 如果能在最右邊放置，就使用最右邊
          if (testX === BOARD_WIDTH - 1) break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              // 如果能在最右邊放置，就使用最右邊
              if (testX === BOARD_WIDTH - 1) break;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (testX === BOARD_WIDTH - 1 && foundValidPosition) break;
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  // 遊戲結束時清理音效
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gameOver) {
      // 停止遊戲音樂，但保留選單音樂的記錄
      audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
      // 設置選單音樂為下次播放的音樂
      audioManager.lastPlayedMusic = 'menu';
    }
  }, [gameOver]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;
```

```javascript
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);
  const [currentMusic, setCurrentMusic] = useState(null);

  // 根據等級選擇背景音樂

      musicKey = 'game2';

      musicKey = 'game1';
    }
    
    if (musicKey !== currentMusic) {
      audioManager.playBackgroundMusic(musicKey);
      setCurrentMusic(musicKey);
    }
  }, [currentMusic]);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);

    // 開始播放遊戲背景音樂
    selectBackgroundMusic(0);
  }, [selectBackgroundMusic]);

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {

    } else if (dy > 0) {

      placePieceOnBoard();

  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    // 使用智能旋轉邏輯（包含牆踢）
    const rotated = rotatePieceWithWallKick(currentPiece, board);
    if (rotated) {

      audioManager.playSound('rotate');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 從最左邊開始測試，找到最左邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = 0; testX <= currentPiece.x; testX++) {

              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
              if (testX === 0) break;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (testX === 0 && foundValidPosition) break;

      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {

      for (let testX = currentPiece.x; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {

          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {

              bestX = testX;

          if (!foundValidPosition) {

    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {

    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  // 遊戲結束時清理音效
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gameOver) {
      // 停止遊戲音樂，但保留選單音樂的記錄
      audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
      // 設置選單音樂為下次播放的音樂
      audioManager.lastPlayedMusic = 'menu';
    }
  }, [gameOver]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;

```

## �� 修復內容

### ❌ 之前的問題
- **向右移動邏輯錯誤** - 從最右邊開始測試會導致方塊移動到無效位置
- **邊界檢查問題** - 沒有正確處理方塊寬度與邊界的關係

### ✅ 現在的解決方案

**修復了向右移動的邏輯：**

**之前的錯誤邏輯：**
```javascript
// 錯誤：從最右邊開始測試
for (let testX = BOARD_WIDTH - 1; testX >= currentPiece.x; testX--) {
  // 這會導致方塊可能移動到超出邊界的位置
}
```

**現在的正確邏輯：**
```javascript
// 正確：從當前位置向右測試
for (let testX = currentPiece.x; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
  // 逐步向右測試，找到最遠的有效位置
  if (!foundValidPosition) {
    break; // 如果無法放置就停止
  }
}
```

### 關鍵改進

**1. 正確的搜索方向：**
- ✅ **從當前位置開始** - 從`currentPiece.x`開始向右測試
- ✅ **逐步向右** - 每次增加1格，直到找到最遠的有效位置
- ✅ **邊界保護** - 確保不會超出`BOARD_WIDTH`

**2. 智能停止條件：**
- ✅ **無效位置停止** - 如果某個X位置無法放置（無論在哪個高度），就停止搜索
- ✅ **使用最後有效位置** - 使用最後一個能找到有效位置的X坐標

**3. 保持下降邏輯：**
- ✅ **當前高度優先** - 先嘗試在當前高度放置
- ✅ **智能下降** - 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置

### 現在的行為

**向右移動：**
1. **從當前位置開始** - 從方塊的當前X位置開始測試
2. **逐步向右** - 每次測試X+1的位置
3. **檢查有效性** - 測試當前高度和下降後的位置
4. **找到最遠位置** - 使用最右邊能放置的位置
5. **邊界保護** - 確保不會超出遊戲板邊界

**各種方塊的表現：**
- ✅ **I形方塊（水平）** - 能正確移動到最右邊的X=6位置
- ✅ **I形方塊（垂直）** - 能正確移動到最右邊的X=9位置  
- ✅ **其他方塊** - 根據寬度正確計算最右邊位置
- ✅ **有障礙物時** - 智能下降到能放置的位置

### 測試場景
1. **I形方塊向右** → 應該能到達正確的最右邊位置 ✅
2. **其他方塊向右** → 根據方塊寬度正確移動 ✅
3. **有障礙物時** → 智能下降到合適位置 ✅
4. **邊界情況** → 不會超出遊戲板邊界 ✅

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import './SettingsPage.css';
import audioManager from '../utils/audioManager';

const SettingsPage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [musicVolume, setMusicVolume] = useState(100);
  const [soundVolume, setSoundVolume] = useState(100);
  const [dropSpeed, setDropSpeed] = useState('medium');

  // 載入設定
  useEffect(() => {
    const savedMusicVolume = localStorage.getItem('musicVolume');
    const savedSoundVolume = localStorage.getItem('soundVolume');
    const savedDropSpeed = localStorage.getItem('dropSpeed');

    if (savedMusicVolume !== null) {
      setMusicVolume(parseInt(savedMusicVolume));
    }
    if (savedSoundVolume !== null) {
      setSoundVolume(parseInt(savedSoundVolume));
    }
    if (savedDropSpeed !== null) {
      setDropSpeed(savedDropSpeed);
    }

    // 應用設定到音頻管理器
    audioManager.setVolume(musicVolume / 100);
    audioManager.setSoundVolume(soundVolume / 100);
  }, []);

  // 音樂音量變更
  const handleMusicVolumeChange = (e) => {
    const volume = parseInt(e.target.value);
    setMusicVolume(volume);
    audioManager.setVolume(volume / 100);
    localStorage.setItem('musicVolume', volume);
  };

  // 音效音量變更
  const handleSoundVolumeChange = (e) => {
    const volume = parseInt(e.target.value);
    setSoundVolume(volume);
    audioManager.setSoundVolume(volume / 100);
    localStorage.setItem('soundVolume', volume);
  };

  // 掉落速度變更
  const handleDropSpeedChange = (e) => {
    const speed = e.target.value;
    setDropSpeed(speed);
    localStorage.setItem('dropSpeed', speed);
  };

  return (
    <div className="settings-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      <div className="settings-content">
        <h1 className="settings-title">遊戲設定</h1>
        
        <div className="settings-section">
          <h2>音頻設定</h2>
          
          <div className="setting-item">
            <label htmlFor="music-volume">音樂音量</label>
            <div className="volume-control">
              <input
                type="range"
                id="music-volume"
                min="0"
                max="100"
                value={musicVolume}
                onChange={handleMusicVolumeChange}
                className="volume-slider"
              />
              <span className="volume-value">{musicVolume}%</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="setting-item">
            <label htmlFor="sound-volume">音效音量</label>
            <div className="volume-control">
              <input
                type="range"
                id="sound-volume"
                min="0"
                max="100"
                value={soundVolume}
                onChange={handleSoundVolumeChange}
                className="volume-slider"
              />
              <span className="volume-value">{soundVolume}%</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="settings-section">
          <h2>遊戲設定</h2>
          
          <div className="setting-item">
            <label htmlFor="drop-speed">方塊掉落速度</label>
            <select
              id="drop-speed"
              value={dropSpeed}
              onChange={handleDropSpeedChange}
              className="speed-select"
            >
              <option value="slow">慢</option>
              <option value="medium">中</option>
              <option value="fast">快</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
          返回主頁
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SettingsPage;
```

現在更新App.js來支援設定頁面：


```javascript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import './App.css';
import HomePage from './components/HomePage';
import GamePage from './components/GamePage';
import ControlsPage from './components/ControlsPage';
import SettingsPage from './components/SettingsPage';
import MusicToggle from './components/MusicToggle';
import audioManager from './utils/audioManager';

function App() {
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState('home'); // 'home', 'game', 'controls'

  const renderPage = () => {
    switch (currentPage) {
      case 'home':
        return <HomePage onStart={() => {
          audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
          setCurrentPage('game');
        }} onControls={() => setCurrentPage('controls')} />;
      case 'game':
        return <GamePage onBack={() => {
          // 重新開始選單音樂
          audioManager.playBackgroundMusic('menu');
          setCurrentPage('home');
        }} />;
      case 'controls':
        return <ControlsPage onBack={() => setCurrentPage('home')} />;
      default:
        return <HomePage onStart={() => {
          audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
          setCurrentPage('game');
        }} onControls={() => setCurrentPage('controls')} />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="App">
      <MusicToggle />
      {renderPage()}
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;
```

現在更新audioManager來支援音量控制：


我需要添加音效音量控制和修改靜音邏輯：


```javascript
// 音效管理器
class AudioManager {
  constructor() {
    this.audioFiles = {
      menu: '/audio/menu.mp3',
      game1: '/audio/game1.mp3',
      game2: '/audio/game2.mp3',
      lineClear: '/audio/line_clear.mp3',
      rotate: '/audio/rotate.mp3',
      move: '/audio/move.mp3',
      drop: '/audio/drop.mp3',
      levelUp: '/audio/level_up.mp3',
      gameOver: '/audio/game_over.mp3'
    };
    
    this.audioInstances = {};
    this.isMuted = false;
    this.volume = 1.0; // 音樂音量 (0-1)
    this.soundVolume = 1.0; // 音效音量 (0-1)
    this.currentBackgroundMusic = null;
    this.lastPlayedMusic = null;
    
    this.initializeAudio();
  }
  
  // 初始化音頻實例
  initializeAudio() {
    Object.keys(this.audioFiles).forEach(key => {
      try {
        const audio = new Audio(this.audioFiles[key]);
        audio.volume = this.volume;
        audio.preload = 'auto';
        this.audioInstances[key] = audio;
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`無法加載音頻文件: ${this.audioFiles[key]}`, error);
      }
    });
  }
  
  // 播放音效
  playSound(soundKey) {
    if (this.isMuted) return;
    
    const audio = this.audioInstances[soundKey];
    if (audio) {
      try {
        audio.currentTime = 0; // 重設到開始
        audio.play().catch(error => {
          console.warn(`播放音效失敗: ${soundKey}`, error);
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`播放音效時發生錯誤: ${soundKey}`, error);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 播放背景音樂
  playBackgroundMusic(musicKey, loop = true) {
    if (this.isMuted) return;
    
    // 如果正在播放相同的音樂，不要重新開始
    if (this.currentBackgroundMusic === musicKey) {
      const audio = this.audioInstances[musicKey];
      if (audio && !audio.paused) {
        return; // 音樂正在播放，不需要重新開始
      }
    }
    
    // 停止其他背景音樂
    Object.keys(this.audioInstances).forEach(key => {
      if (['menu', 'game1', 'game2'].includes(key) && key !== musicKey) {
        const audio = this.audioInstances[key];
        if (audio) {
          audio.pause();
          audio.currentTime = 0;
        }
      }
    });
    
    const audio = this.audioInstances[musicKey];
    if (audio) {
      try {
        audio.loop = loop;
        audio.volume = this.volume * 0.7; // 背景音樂音量稍低
        this.currentBackgroundMusic = musicKey;
        this.lastPlayedMusic = musicKey;
        audio.play().catch(error => {
          console.warn(`播放背景音樂失敗: ${musicKey}`, error);
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`播放背景音樂時發生錯誤: ${musicKey}`, error);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 停止背景音樂
  stopBackgroundMusic() {
    ['menu', 'game1', 'game2'].forEach(key => {
      const audio = this.audioInstances[key];
      if (audio) {
        audio.pause();
        audio.currentTime = 0;
      }
    });
    this.currentBackgroundMusic = null;
    // 注意：不清除 lastPlayedMusic，以便取消靜音時能恢復
  }
  
  // 完全停止音樂（用於遊戲結束時）
  stopAllMusic() {
    this.stopBackgroundMusic();
    this.lastPlayedMusic = null;
  }
  
  // 設置音量
  setVolume(volume) {
    this.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume));
    
    Object.values(this.audioInstances).forEach(audio => {
      if (audio) {
        // 背景音樂音量稍低
        const isBackground = ['menu', 'game1', 'game2'].includes(
          Object.keys(this.audioInstances).find(key => this.audioInstances[key] === audio)
        );
        audio.volume = this.volume * (isBackground ? 0.7 : 1);
      }
    });
  }
  
  // 靜音/取消靜音
  toggleMute() {
    this.isMuted = !this.isMuted;
    
    if (this.isMuted) {
      this.stopBackgroundMusic();
    } else {
      // 取消靜音時，恢復播放之前的音樂
      if (this.lastPlayedMusic) {
        this.playBackgroundMusic(this.lastPlayedMusic);
      }
    }
    
    return this.isMuted;
  }
  
  // 設置靜音狀態
  setMuted(muted) {
    this.isMuted = muted;
    
    if (this.isMuted) {
      this.stopBackgroundMusic();
    } else {
      // 取消靜音時，恢復播放之前的音樂
      if (this.lastPlayedMusic) {
        this.playBackgroundMusic(this.lastPlayedMusic);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 獲取靜音狀態
  getMuted() {
    return this.isMuted;
  }
  
  // 獲取音量
  getVolume() {
    return this.volume;
  }
  
  // 檢查是否正在播放選單音樂
  isPlayingMenuMusic() {
    return this.currentBackgroundMusic === 'menu';
  }
  
  // 獲取當前播放的背景音樂
  getCurrentBackgroundMusic() {
    return this.currentBackgroundMusic;
  }
}

// 創建全局音效管理器實例
const audioManager = new AudioManager();

export default audioManager;
```

```javascript
        const audio = this.audioInstances[key];
        if (audio) {
          audio.pause();
          audio.currentTime = 0;
        }
      }
    });
    
    const audio = this.audioInstances[musicKey];
    if (audio) {
      try {
        audio.loop = loop;
        audio.volume = this.volume * 0.7; // 背景音樂音量稍低
        this.currentBackgroundMusic = musicKey;
        this.lastPlayedMusic = musicKey;
        audio.play().catch(error => {
          console.warn(`播放背景音樂失敗: ${musicKey}`, error);
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`播放背景音樂時發生錯誤: ${musicKey}`, error);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 停止背景音樂
  stopBackgroundMusic() {
    ['menu', 'game1', 'game2'].forEach(key => {
      const audio = this.audioInstances[key];
      if (audio) {
        audio.pause();
        audio.currentTime = 0;
      }
    });
    this.currentBackgroundMusic = null;
    // 注意：不清除 lastPlayedMusic，以便取消靜音時能恢復
  }
  
  // 完全停止音樂（用於遊戲結束時）
  stopAllMusic() {
    this.stopBackgroundMusic();
    this.lastPlayedMusic = null;
  }
  
  // 設置音量
  setVolume(volume) {
    this.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume));
    
    Object.values(this.audioInstances).forEach(audio => {
      if (audio) {
        // 背景音樂音量稍低
        const isBackground = ['menu', 'game1', 'game2'].includes(
          Object.keys(this.audioInstances).find(key => this.audioInstances[key] === audio)
        );
        audio.volume = this.volume * (isBackground ? 0.7 : 1);
      }
    });
  }
  
  // 靜音/取消靜音
  toggleMute() {
    this.isMuted = !this.isMuted;
    
    if (this.isMuted) {
      this.stopBackgroundMusic();
    } else {
      // 取消靜音時，恢復播放之前的音樂
      if (this.lastPlayedMusic) {
        this.playBackgroundMusic(this.lastPlayedMusic);
      }
    }
    
    return this.isMuted;
  }
  
  // 設置靜音狀態
  setMuted(muted) {
    this.isMuted = muted;
    
    if (this.isMuted) {
      this.stopBackgroundMusic();
    } else {
      // 取消靜音時，恢復播放之前的音樂
      if (this.lastPlayedMusic) {
        this.playBackgroundMusic(this.lastPlayedMusic);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 獲取靜音狀態
  getMuted() {
    return this.isMuted;
  }
  
  // 獲取音量
  getVolume() {
    return this.volume;
  }
  
  // 檢查是否正在播放選單音樂
  isPlayingMenuMusic() {
    return this.currentBackgroundMusic === 'menu';
  }
  
  // 獲取當前播放的背景音樂
  getCurrentBackgroundMusic() {
    return this.currentBackgroundMusic;
  }
}

// 創建全局音效管理器實例
const audioManager = new AudioManager();

export default audioManager;
```

```javascript
// 音效管理器
class AudioManager {
  constructor() {
    this.audioFiles = {
      menu: '/audio/menu.mp3',
      game1: '/audio/game1.mp3',
      game2: '/audio/game2.mp3',
      lineClear: '/audio/line_clear.mp3',
      rotate: '/audio/rotate.mp3',
      move: '/audio/move.mp3',
      drop: '/audio/drop.mp3',
      levelUp: '/audio/level_up.mp3',
      gameOver: '/audio/game_over.mp3'
    };
    
    this.audioInstances = {};
    this.isMuted = false;
    this.volume = 1.0; // 音樂音量 (0-1)
    this.soundVolume = 1.0; // 音效音量 (0-1)
    this.currentBackgroundMusic = null;
    this.lastPlayedMusic = null;
    
    this.initializeAudio();
  }
  
  // 初始化音頻實例
  initializeAudio() {
    Object.keys(this.audioFiles).forEach(key => {
      try {
        const audio = new Audio(this.audioFiles[key]);
        audio.volume = this.volume;
        audio.preload = 'auto';
        this.audioInstances[key] = audio;
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`無法加載音頻文件: ${this.audioFiles[key]}`, error);
      }
    });
  }
  
  // 播放音效
  playSound(soundKey) {
    if (this.isMuted || this.soundVolume === 0) return;
    
    const audio = this.audioInstances[soundKey];
    if (audio) {
      try {
        audio.currentTime = 0; // 重設到開始
        audio.play().catch(error => {
          console.warn(`播放音效失敗: ${soundKey}`, error);
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`播放音效時發生錯誤: ${soundKey}`, error);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 設置音樂音量 (0-1)
  setVolume(volume) {
    this.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume));
    this.updateAudioVolumes();
  }

  // 設置音效音量 (0-1)
  setSoundVolume(volume) {
    this.soundVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume));
    this.updateAudioVolumes();
  }

  // 更新所有音頻實例的音量
  updateAudioVolumes() {
    Object.keys(this.audioInstances).forEach(key => {
      const audio = this.audioInstances[key];
      if (audio) {
        const isBackground = ['menu', 'game1', 'game2'].includes(key);
        if (isBackground) {
          audio.volume = this.volume * 0.7 * (this.isMuted ? 0 : 1);
        } else {
          audio.volume = this.soundVolume * (this.isMuted ? 0 : 1);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  // 播放背景音樂
  playBackgroundMusic(musicKey, loop = true) {
    if (this.isMuted || this.volume === 0) return;
    
    // 如果正在播放相同的音樂，不要重新開始
    if (this.currentBackgroundMusic === musicKey) {
      const audio = this.audioInstances[musicKey];
      if (audio && !audio.paused) {
        return; // 音樂正在播放，不需要重新開始
      }
    }
    
    // 停止其他背景音樂
    Object.keys(this.audioInstances).forEach(key => {

        if (audio) {

          audio.currentTime = 0;
        }
      }
    });

    if (audio) {
      try {

        audio.volume = this.volume * 0.7; // 背景音樂音量稍低
        this.currentBackgroundMusic = musicKey;
        this.lastPlayedMusic = musicKey;
        audio.play().catch(error => {
          console.warn(`播放背景音樂失敗: ${musicKey}`, error);

  }

      if (audio) {

        );
        audio.volume = this.volume * (isBackground ? 0.7 : 1);
      }
    });
```

```javascript
  // 靜音/取消靜音（現在基於音量控制）
  toggleMute() {
    if (this.volume > 0 && this.soundVolume > 0) {
```

```javascript
  SINGLE: 100,
  DOUBLE: 300,
  TRIPLE: 500,
  TETRIS: 800,
  SOFT_DROP: 1
};

// 等級系統 - 更快的速度變化
export const LEVEL_SPEEDS = [
  800,  // 等級 0 - 0.8秒
  700,  // 等級 1 - 0.7秒
  600,  // 等級 2 - 0.6秒
  500,  // 等級 3 - 0.5秒
  400,  // 等級 4 - 0.4秒
  350,  // 等級 5 - 0.35秒
  300,  // 等級 6 - 0.3秒
  250,  // 等級 7 - 0.25秒
  200,  // 等級 8 - 0.2秒
  180,  // 等級 9 - 0.18秒
  160,  // 等級 10 - 0.16秒
  140,  // 等級 11 - 0.14秒
  120,  // 等級 12 - 0.12秒
  100,  // 等級 13 - 0.1秒
  90,   // 等級 14 - 0.09秒
  80,   // 等級 15 - 0.08秒
  70,   // 等級 16 - 0.07秒
  60,   // 等級 17 - 0.06秒
  50,   // 等級 18 - 0.05秒
  40,   // 等級 19 - 0.04秒
  30,   // 等級 20+ - 0.03秒 (最快)
];

// 獲取指定等級的下降速度
export const getLevelSpeed = (level, speedMultiplier = 1) => {
  const speedIndex = Math.min(level, LEVEL_SPEEDS.length - 1);
  const baseSpeed = LEVEL_SPEEDS[speedIndex];
  return Math.max(30, baseSpeed / speedMultiplier); // 最快不超過30ms
};

// 掉落速度倍數設定

  slow: 0.5,    // 慢速：0.5倍
  medium: 1,    // 中速：1倍（預設）
  fast: 2       // 快速：2倍
};
```
