```javascript
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);
  const [currentMusic, setCurrentMusic] = useState(null);

  // 根據等級選擇背景音樂
  const selectBackgroundMusic = useCallback((level) => {
    let musicKey;
    if (level >= 5) {
      musicKey = 'game2';
    } else {
      musicKey = 'game1';
    }
    
    if (musicKey !== currentMusic) {
      audioManager.playBackgroundMusic(musicKey);
      setCurrentMusic(musicKey);
    }
  }, [currentMusic]);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
    setCurrentMusic(null);
    
    // 開始播放遊戲背景音樂
    selectBackgroundMusic(0);
  }, [selectBackgroundMusic]);

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    // 使用智能旋轉邏輯（包含牆踢）
    const rotated = rotatePieceWithWallKick(currentPiece, board);
    if (rotated) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
      // 播放旋轉音效
      audioManager.playSound('rotate');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 從最左邊開始測試，找到最左邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = 0; testX <= currentPiece.x; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
          if (testX === 0) break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
              if (testX === 0) break;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (testX === 0 && foundValidPosition) break;
        }
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 從當前位置向右測試，找到最右邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = currentPiece.x; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          // 如果這個X位置無法放置（無論在什麼高度），就停止搜索
          if (!foundValidPosition) {
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  // 遊戲結束時清理音效
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gameOver) {
      // 停止遊戲音樂，但保留選單音樂的記錄
      audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
      // 設置選單音樂為下次播放的音樂
      audioManager.lastPlayedMusic = 'menu';
    }
  }, [gameOver]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;
```

```javascript

  rotatePieceWithWallKick
} from '../utils/gameLogic';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());

  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);

  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);

  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);
  const [currentMusic, setCurrentMusic] = useState(null);
  const [dropSpeed, setDropSpeed] = useState('medium');

  // 根據等級選擇背景音樂
  const selectBackgroundMusic = useCallback((level) => {
    let musicKey;
    if (level >= 5) {
      musicKey = 'game2';
    } else {
      musicKey = 'game1';
    }
    
    if (musicKey !== currentMusic) {
      audioManager.playBackgroundMusic(musicKey);
      setCurrentMusic(musicKey);
    }
  }, [currentMusic]);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
    setCurrentMusic(null);
    
    // 開始播放遊戲背景音樂
    selectBackgroundMusic(0);
  }, [selectBackgroundMusic]);

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    // 使用智能旋轉邏輯（包含牆踢）
    const rotated = rotatePieceWithWallKick(currentPiece, board);
    if (rotated) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
      // 播放旋轉音效
      audioManager.playSound('rotate');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 從最左邊開始測試，找到最左邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = 0; testX <= currentPiece.x; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;

          if (testX === 0) break;

          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
              if (testX === 0) break;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (testX === 0 && foundValidPosition) break;
        }
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 從當前位置向右測試，找到最右邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = currentPiece.x; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              break;
            }
          }

          if (!foundValidPosition) {
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  // 遊戲結束時清理音效
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gameOver) {
      // 停止遊戲音樂，但保留選單音樂的記錄
      audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
      // 設置選單音樂為下次播放的音樂
      audioManager.lastPlayedMusic = 'menu';
    }
  }, [gameOver]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;
```

現在添加載入設定的useEffect：


```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './GamePage.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, getLevelSpeed, DROP_SPEED_MULTIPLIERS } from '../utils/gameConstants';
import audioManager from '../utils/audioManager';
import { 
  createEmptyBoard, 
  getRandomPiece, 
  isValidPosition, 
  placePiece, 
  clearLines, 
  calculateScore,
  getGhostPiece,
  rotatePiece,
  rotatePieceWithWallKick
} from '../utils/gameLogic';
import GameBoard from './GameBoard';
import GameInfo from './GameInfo';
import HoldArea from './HoldArea';
import NextPieces from './NextPieces';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);
  const [currentMusic, setCurrentMusic] = useState(null);
  const [dropSpeed, setDropSpeed] = useState('medium');

  // 載入設定
  useEffect(() => {
    const savedDropSpeed = localStorage.getItem('dropSpeed');
    if (savedDropSpeed !== null) {
      setDropSpeed(savedDropSpeed);
    }
  }, []);

  // 根據等級選擇背景音樂
  const selectBackgroundMusic = useCallback((level) => {
    let musicKey;
    if (level >= 5) {
      musicKey = 'game2';
    } else {
      musicKey = 'game1';
    }
    
    if (musicKey !== currentMusic) {
      audioManager.playBackgroundMusic(musicKey);
      setCurrentMusic(musicKey);
    }
  }, [currentMusic]);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
    setCurrentMusic(null);
    
    // 開始播放遊戲背景音樂
    selectBackgroundMusic(0);
  }, [selectBackgroundMusic]);

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    // 使用智能旋轉邏輯（包含牆踢）
    const rotated = rotatePieceWithWallKick(currentPiece, board);
    if (rotated) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
      // 播放旋轉音效
      audioManager.playSound('rotate');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 從最左邊開始測試，找到最左邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = 0; testX <= currentPiece.x; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
          if (testX === 0) break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
              if (testX === 0) break;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (testX === 0 && foundValidPosition) break;
        }
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 從當前位置向右測試，找到最右邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = currentPiece.x; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;

          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          // 如果這個X位置無法放置（無論在什麼高度），就停止搜索
          if (!foundValidPosition) {
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);

        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };

        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),

      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);

        case 'ArrowRight':

          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {

          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);

          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':

          movePiece(0, 1);

        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();

      }

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;

    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {

      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  // 遊戲結束時清理音效
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gameOver) {
      // 停止遊戲音樂，但保留選單音樂的記錄
      audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
      // 設置選單音樂為下次播放的音樂
      audioManager.lastPlayedMusic = 'menu';

  }, [gameOver]);

  return (

        <div className="game-sidebar left">

        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">

              ← 返回主頁
            </button>

              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (

              {levelUpMessage}

          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (

          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;

```

現在更新遊戲循環來使用掉落速度設定：


```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './GamePage.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, getLevelSpeed, DROP_SPEED_MULTIPLIERS } from '../utils/gameConstants';
import audioManager from '../utils/audioManager';
import { 
  createEmptyBoard, 
  getRandomPiece, 
  isValidPosition, 
  placePiece, 
  clearLines, 
  calculateScore,
  getGhostPiece,
  rotatePiece,
  rotatePieceWithWallKick
} from '../utils/gameLogic';
import GameBoard from './GameBoard';
import GameInfo from './GameInfo';
import HoldArea from './HoldArea';
import NextPieces from './NextPieces';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);
  const [currentMusic, setCurrentMusic] = useState(null);
  const [dropSpeed, setDropSpeed] = useState('medium');

  // 載入設定
  useEffect(() => {
    const savedDropSpeed = localStorage.getItem('dropSpeed');
    if (savedDropSpeed !== null) {
      setDropSpeed(savedDropSpeed);
    }
  }, []);

  // 根據等級選擇背景音樂
  const selectBackgroundMusic = useCallback((level) => {
    let musicKey;
    if (level >= 5) {
      musicKey = 'game2';
    } else {
      musicKey = 'game1';
    }
    
    if (musicKey !== currentMusic) {
      audioManager.playBackgroundMusic(musicKey);
      setCurrentMusic(musicKey);
    }
  }, [currentMusic]);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
    setCurrentMusic(null);
    
    // 開始播放遊戲背景音樂
    selectBackgroundMusic(0);
  }, [selectBackgroundMusic]);

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    // 使用智能旋轉邏輯（包含牆踢）
    const rotated = rotatePieceWithWallKick(currentPiece, board);
    if (rotated) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
      // 播放旋轉音效
      audioManager.playSound('rotate');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 從最左邊開始測試，找到最左邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = 0; testX <= currentPiece.x; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
          if (testX === 0) break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
              if (testX === 0) break;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (testX === 0 && foundValidPosition) break;
        }
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 從當前位置向右測試，找到最右邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = currentPiece.x; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          // 如果這個X位置無法放置（無論在什麼高度），就停止搜索
          if (!foundValidPosition) {
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const speedMultiplier = DROP_SPEED_MULTIPLIERS[dropSpeed];
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level, speedMultiplier));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, dropSpeed, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  // 遊戲結束時清理音效
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gameOver) {
      // 停止遊戲音樂，但保留選單音樂的記錄
      audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
      // 設置選單音樂為下次播放的音樂
      audioManager.lastPlayedMusic = 'menu';
    }
  }, [gameOver]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;

```

## 🎛️ 設定頁面功能完成

### ✅ 新增功能

**1. 設定頁面組件 (`SettingsPage.js`)：**
- ✅ **音樂音量控制** - 0-100滑桿，預設100
- ✅ **音效音量控制** - 0-100滑桿，預設100  
- ✅ **方塊掉落速度** - 下拉選單（慢/中/快），預設中
- ✅ **設定持久化** - 使用localStorage保存設定
- ✅ **美觀UI** - 與遊戲風格一致的設計

**2. 主頁更新：**
- ✅ **新增設定按鈕** - 橙色漸層按鈕
- ✅ **三個按鈕佈局** - START、按鍵介紹、設定
- ✅ **響應式設計** - 支援不同螢幕尺寸

**3. 音量控制系統：**
- ✅ **分離音量控制** - 音樂和音效獨立控制
- ✅ **實時更新** - 滑動時立即生效
- ✅ **智能靜音** - 基於音量設置而非簡單開關

**4. 掉落速度系統：**
- ✅ **三種速度** - 慢(0.5x)、中(1x)、快(2x)
- ✅ **動態調整** - 遊戲中即時生效
- ✅ **設定持久化** - 重啟遊戲後保持設定

**5. 靜音按鈕邏輯更新：**
- ✅ **基於音量控制** - 靜音時設音量為0，取消靜音時恢復
- ✅ **智能恢復** - 從localStorage恢復上次的音量設置
- ✅ **音樂恢復** - 取消靜音時自動恢復背景音樂

### �� 設定選項詳情

**音樂音量：**
- **範圍** - 0-100%
- **預設** - 100%
- **效果** - 控制所有背景音樂音量

**音效音量：**
- **範圍** - 0-100%
- **預設** - 100%
- **效果** - 控制所有遊戲音效音量

**方塊掉落速度：**
- **慢** - 0.5倍速度（更慢下降）
- **中** - 1倍速度（預設）
- **快** - 2倍速度（更快下降）

### 🔧 技術實現

**音頻管理器更新：**
- ✅ **分離音量控制** - `setVolume()` 和 `setSoundVolume()`
- ✅ **智能靜音邏輯** - 基於音量值而非簡單布林值
- ✅ **設定持久化** - 與localStorage整合

**遊戲邏輯更新：**
- ✅ **動態速度調整** - `getLevelSpeed()` 支援速度倍數
- ✅ **設定載入** - 遊戲開始時載入用戶設定
- ✅ **即時生效** - 設定變更立即應用

**UI/UX設計：**
- ✅ **一致性** - 與遊戲整體風格保持一致
- ✅ **直觀操作** - 滑桿和下拉選單易於使用
- ✅ **視覺反饋** - 即時顯示數值變更

### �� 使用方式

1. **進入設定** - 主頁點擊"設定"按鈕
2. **調整音量** - 拖動滑桿調整音樂/音效音量
3. **選擇速度** - 下拉選單選擇方塊掉落速度
4. **自動保存** - 設定自動保存到localStorage
5. **即時生效** - 設定變更立即在遊戲中生效

```javascript
import React from 'react';
import './StartGameDialog.css';

const StartGameDialog = ({ onStart, onBack }) => {
  // 從localStorage獲取當前設定
  const getCurrentSettings = () => {
    const musicVolume = localStorage.getItem('musicVolume') || '100';
    const soundVolume = localStorage.getItem('soundVolume') || '100';
    const dropSpeed = localStorage.getItem('dropSpeed') || 'medium';
    
    return {
      musicVolume: parseInt(musicVolume),
      soundVolume: parseInt(soundVolume),
      dropSpeed: dropSpeed
    };
  };

  const settings = getCurrentSettings();

  const getSpeedText = (speed) => {
    switch (speed) {
      case 'slow': return '慢';
      case 'medium': return '中';
      case 'fast': return '快';
      default: return '中';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="dialog-overlay">
      <div className="start-dialog">
        <h2 className="dialog-title">開始遊戲</h2>
        
        <div className="settings-display">
          <h3>當前設定</h3>
          <div className="setting-item">
            <span className="setting-label">音樂音量：</span>
            <span className="setting-value">{settings.musicVolume}%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="setting-item">
            <span className="setting-label">音效音量：</span>
            <span className="setting-value">{settings.soundVolume}%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="setting-item">
            <span className="setting-label">掉落速度：</span>
            <span className="setting-value">{getSpeedText(settings.dropSpeed)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="dialog-buttons">
          <button className="start-button" onClick={onStart}>
            開始遊戲
          </button>
          <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
            返回主頁
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default StartGameDialog;
```

現在更新GamePage.js來整合這些對話框：


```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './GamePage.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, getLevelSpeed, DROP_SPEED_MULTIPLIERS } from '../utils/gameConstants';
import audioManager from '../utils/audioManager';
import { 
  createEmptyBoard, 
  getRandomPiece, 
  isValidPosition, 
  placePiece, 
  clearLines, 
  calculateScore,
  getGhostPiece,
  rotatePiece,
  rotatePieceWithWallKick
} from '../utils/gameLogic';
import GameBoard from './GameBoard';
import GameInfo from './GameInfo';
import HoldArea from './HoldArea';
import NextPieces from './NextPieces';
import StartGameDialog from './StartGameDialog';
import GameOverDialog from './GameOverDialog';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);
  const [currentMusic, setCurrentMusic] = useState(null);
  const [dropSpeed, setDropSpeed] = useState('medium');

  // 載入設定
  useEffect(() => {
    const savedDropSpeed = localStorage.getItem('dropSpeed');
    if (savedDropSpeed !== null) {
      setDropSpeed(savedDropSpeed);
    }
  }, []);

  // 根據等級選擇背景音樂
  const selectBackgroundMusic = useCallback((level) => {
    let musicKey;
    if (level >= 5) {
      musicKey = 'game2';
    } else {
      musicKey = 'game1';
    }
    
    if (musicKey !== currentMusic) {
      audioManager.playBackgroundMusic(musicKey);
      setCurrentMusic(musicKey);
    }
  }, [currentMusic]);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
    setCurrentMusic(null);
    
    // 開始播放遊戲背景音樂
    selectBackgroundMusic(0);
  }, [selectBackgroundMusic]);

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    // 使用智能旋轉邏輯（包含牆踢）
    const rotated = rotatePieceWithWallKick(currentPiece, board);
    if (rotated) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
      // 播放旋轉音效
      audioManager.playSound('rotate');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 從最左邊開始測試，找到最左邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = 0; testX <= currentPiece.x; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
          if (testX === 0) break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
              if (testX === 0) break;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (testX === 0 && foundValidPosition) break;
        }
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 從當前位置向右測試，找到最右邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = currentPiece.x; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          // 如果這個X位置無法放置（無論在什麼高度），就停止搜索
          if (!foundValidPosition) {
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    const speedMultiplier = DROP_SPEED_MULTIPLIERS[dropSpeed];
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level, speedMultiplier));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, dropSpeed, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  // 遊戲結束時清理音效
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gameOver) {
      // 停止遊戲音樂，但保留選單音樂的記錄
      audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
      // 設置選單音樂為下次播放的音樂
      audioManager.lastPlayedMusic = 'menu';
    }
  }, [gameOver]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;
```
