```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './GamePage.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, getLevelSpeed, DROP_SPEED_MULTIPLIERS } from '../utils/gameConstants';
import audioManager from '../utils/audioManager';
import { 
  createEmptyBoard, 
  getRandomPiece, 
  isValidPosition, 
  placePiece, 
  clearLines, 
  calculateScore,
  getGhostPiece,
  rotatePiece,
  rotatePieceWithWallKick
} from '../utils/gameLogic';
import GameBoard from './GameBoard';
import GameInfo from './GameInfo';
import HoldArea from './HoldArea';
import NextPieces from './NextPieces';
import StartGameDialog from './StartGameDialog';
import GameOverDialog from './GameOverDialog';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);
  const [currentMusic, setCurrentMusic] = useState(null);
  const [dropSpeed, setDropSpeed] = useState('medium');
  const [showStartDialog, setShowStartDialog] = useState(true);
  const [showGameOverDialog, setShowGameOverDialog] = useState(false);

  // 載入設定
  useEffect(() => {
    const savedDropSpeed = localStorage.getItem('dropSpeed');
    if (savedDropSpeed !== null) {
      setDropSpeed(savedDropSpeed);
    }
  }, []);

  // 根據等級選擇背景音樂
  const selectBackgroundMusic = useCallback((level) => {
    let musicKey;
    if (level >= 5) {
      musicKey = 'game2';
    } else {
      musicKey = 'game1';
    }
    
    if (musicKey !== currentMusic) {
      audioManager.playBackgroundMusic(musicKey);
      setCurrentMusic(musicKey);
    }
  }, [currentMusic]);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
    setCurrentMusic(null);
    setShowStartDialog(false);
    setShowGameOverDialog(false);
    
    // 開始播放遊戲背景音樂
    selectBackgroundMusic(0);
  }, [selectBackgroundMusic]);

  // 開始遊戲
  const handleStartGame = () => {
    initGame();
  };

  // 重新開始遊戲
  const handleRestartGame = () => {
    initGame();
  };

  // 返回主頁
  const handleBackToMenu = () => {
    setShowGameOverDialog(false);
    onBack();
  };

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    // 使用智能旋轉邏輯（包含牆踢）
    const rotated = rotatePieceWithWallKick(currentPiece, board);
    if (rotated) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
      // 播放旋轉音效
      audioManager.playSound('rotate');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 從最左邊開始測試，找到最左邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = 0; testX <= currentPiece.x; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
          if (testX === 0) break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
              if (testX === 0) break;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (testX === 0 && foundValidPosition) break;
        }
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 從當前位置向右測試，找到最右邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = currentPiece.x; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          // 如果這個X位置無法放置（無論在什麼高度），就停止搜索
          if (!foundValidPosition) {
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      setShowGameOverDialog(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      setShowGameOverDialog(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused || showStartDialog || showGameOverDialog) return;

    const speedMultiplier = DROP_SPEED_MULTIPLIERS[dropSpeed];
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level, speedMultiplier));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, dropSpeed, showStartDialog, showGameOverDialog, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  // 遊戲結束時清理音效
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gameOver) {
      // 停止遊戲音樂，但保留選單音樂的記錄
      audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
      // 設置選單音樂為下次播放的音樂
      audioManager.lastPlayedMusic = 'menu';
    }
  }, [gameOver]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;

```

現在在render部分添加對話框：


```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './GamePage.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, getLevelSpeed, DROP_SPEED_MULTIPLIERS } from '../utils/gameConstants';
import audioManager from '../utils/audioManager';
import { 
  createEmptyBoard, 
  getRandomPiece, 
  isValidPosition, 
  placePiece, 
  clearLines, 
  calculateScore,
  getGhostPiece,
  rotatePiece,
  rotatePieceWithWallKick
} from '../utils/gameLogic';
import GameBoard from './GameBoard';
import GameInfo from './GameInfo';
import HoldArea from './HoldArea';
import NextPieces from './NextPieces';
import StartGameDialog from './StartGameDialog';
import GameOverDialog from './GameOverDialog';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);
  const [currentMusic, setCurrentMusic] = useState(null);
  const [dropSpeed, setDropSpeed] = useState('medium');
  const [showStartDialog, setShowStartDialog] = useState(true);
  const [showGameOverDialog, setShowGameOverDialog] = useState(false);

  // 載入設定
  useEffect(() => {
    const savedDropSpeed = localStorage.getItem('dropSpeed');
    if (savedDropSpeed !== null) {
      setDropSpeed(savedDropSpeed);
    }
  }, []);

  // 根據等級選擇背景音樂
  const selectBackgroundMusic = useCallback((level) => {
    let musicKey;
    if (level >= 5) {
      musicKey = 'game2';
    } else {
      musicKey = 'game1';
    }
    
    if (musicKey !== currentMusic) {
      audioManager.playBackgroundMusic(musicKey);
      setCurrentMusic(musicKey);
    }
  }, [currentMusic]);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
    setCurrentMusic(null);
    setShowStartDialog(false);
    setShowGameOverDialog(false);
    
    // 開始播放遊戲背景音樂
    selectBackgroundMusic(0);
  }, [selectBackgroundMusic]);

  // 開始遊戲
  const handleStartGame = () => {
    initGame();
  };

  // 重新開始遊戲
  const handleRestartGame = () => {
    initGame();
  };

  // 返回主頁
  const handleBackToMenu = () => {
    setShowGameOverDialog(false);
    onBack();
  };

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    // 使用智能旋轉邏輯（包含牆踢）
    const rotated = rotatePieceWithWallKick(currentPiece, board);
    if (rotated) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
      // 播放旋轉音效
      audioManager.playSound('rotate');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 從最左邊開始測試，找到最左邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = 0; testX <= currentPiece.x; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
          if (testX === 0) break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
              if (testX === 0) break;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (testX === 0 && foundValidPosition) break;
        }
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 從當前位置向右測試，找到最右邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = currentPiece.x; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          // 如果這個X位置無法放置（無論在什麼高度），就停止搜索
          if (!foundValidPosition) {
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      setShowGameOverDialog(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      setShowGameOverDialog(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused || showStartDialog || showGameOverDialog) return;

    const speedMultiplier = DROP_SPEED_MULTIPLIERS[dropSpeed];
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level, speedMultiplier));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, dropSpeed, showStartDialog, showGameOverDialog, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  // 遊戲結束時清理音效
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gameOver) {
      // 停止遊戲音樂，但保留選單音樂的記錄
      audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
      // 設置選單音樂為下次播放的音樂
      audioManager.lastPlayedMusic = 'menu';
    }
  }, [gameOver]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
          
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* 開始遊戲對話框 */}
      {showStartDialog && (
        <StartGameDialog 
          onStart={handleStartGame}
          onBack={onBack}
        />
      )}
      
      {/* 遊戲結束對話框 */}
      {showGameOverDialog && (
        <GameOverDialog 
          score={score}
          level={level}
          lines={lines}
          onRestart={handleRestartGame}
          onBack={handleBackToMenu}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;
```

完成！我已經成功創建了半透明的對話框系統。

## �� 半透明對話框系統完成

### ✅ 新增功能

**1. 開始遊戲對話框 (`StartGameDialog.js`)：**
- ✅ **半透明背景** - 使用backdrop-filter模糊效果
- ✅ **當前設定顯示** - 顯示音樂音量、音效音量、掉落速度
- ✅ **動畫效果** - 滑入動畫和縮放效果
- ✅ **兩個按鈕** - 開始遊戲和返回主頁

**2. 遊戲結束對話框 (`GameOverDialog.js`)：**
- ✅ **分數顯示** - 分數、等級、消除行數
- ✅ **紅色主題** - 與遊戲結束氛圍相符
- ✅ **脈衝動畫** - 標題有呼吸燈效果
- ✅ **兩個按鈕** - 重新開始和返回主頁

**3. 整合到GamePage：**
- ✅ **狀態管理** - showStartDialog和showGameOverDialog狀態
- ✅ **遊戲循環控制** - 對話框顯示時暫停遊戲
- ✅ **事件處理** - 開始、重新開始、返回主頁的處理函數

### 🎨 視覺設計特點

**開始遊戲對話框：**
- **青色主題** - 與遊戲整體風格一致
- **設定展示區** - 半透明背景顯示當前設定
- **滑桿樣式** - 與設定頁面保持一致的設計語言

**遊戲結束對話框：**
- **紅色主題** - 突出遊戲結束的氛圍
- **分數展示** - 清晰的數據展示
- **脈衝效果** - 標題有呼吸燈動畫增加視覺衝擊

**共同特點：**
- ✅ **半透明覆蓋層** - 70%透明度的黑色背景
- ✅ **模糊效果** - backdrop-filter: blur(5px)
- ✅ **滑入動畫** - 從上方滑入並縮放
- ✅ **響應式設計** - 支援不同螢幕尺寸

### �� 技術實現

**對話框狀態管理：**
```javascript
const [showStartDialog, setShowStartDialog] = useState(true);
const [showGameOverDialog, setShowGameOverDialog] = useState(false);
```

**遊戲循環控制：**
```javascript
if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused || showStartDialog || showGameOverDialog) return;
```

**設定讀取：**
```javascript
const getCurrentSettings = () => {

};
```

### �� 使用流程

**開始遊戲流程：**
1. **進入遊戲頁面** → 顯示開始對話框
2. **查看當前設定** → 音樂音量、音效音量、掉落速度
3. **點擊開始遊戲** → 關閉對話框，開始遊戲
4. **點擊返回主頁** → 回到主頁

**遊戲結束流程：**
1. **遊戲結束** → 自動顯示結束對話框
2. **查看最終分數** → 分數、等級、消除行數
3. **點擊重新開始** → 重新初始化遊戲
4. **點擊返回主頁** → 回到主頁

首先讓我檢查當前的GamePage佈局：


現在我需要將GameInfo組件移到右側邊欄。讓我修改佈局：


```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './GamePage.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, getLevelSpeed, DROP_SPEED_MULTIPLIERS } from '../utils/gameConstants';
import audioManager from '../utils/audioManager';
import { 
  createEmptyBoard, 
  getRandomPiece, 
  isValidPosition, 
  placePiece, 
  clearLines, 
  calculateScore,
  getGhostPiece,
  rotatePiece,
  rotatePieceWithWallKick
} from '../utils/gameLogic';
import GameBoard from './GameBoard';
import GameInfo from './GameInfo';
import HoldArea from './HoldArea';
import NextPieces from './NextPieces';
import StartGameDialog from './StartGameDialog';
import GameOverDialog from './GameOverDialog';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);
  const [currentMusic, setCurrentMusic] = useState(null);
  const [dropSpeed, setDropSpeed] = useState('medium');
  const [showStartDialog, setShowStartDialog] = useState(true);
  const [showGameOverDialog, setShowGameOverDialog] = useState(false);

  // 載入設定
  useEffect(() => {
    const savedDropSpeed = localStorage.getItem('dropSpeed');
    if (savedDropSpeed !== null) {
      setDropSpeed(savedDropSpeed);
    }
  }, []);

  // 根據等級選擇背景音樂
  const selectBackgroundMusic = useCallback((level) => {
    let musicKey;
    if (level >= 5) {
      musicKey = 'game2';
    } else {
      musicKey = 'game1';
    }
    
    if (musicKey !== currentMusic) {
      audioManager.playBackgroundMusic(musicKey);
      setCurrentMusic(musicKey);
    }
  }, [currentMusic]);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
    setCurrentMusic(null);
    setShowStartDialog(false);
    setShowGameOverDialog(false);
    
    // 開始播放遊戲背景音樂
    selectBackgroundMusic(0);
  }, [selectBackgroundMusic]);

  // 開始遊戲
  const handleStartGame = () => {
    initGame();
  };

  // 重新開始遊戲
  const handleRestartGame = () => {
    initGame();
  };

  // 返回主頁
  const handleBackToMenu = () => {
    setShowGameOverDialog(false);
    onBack();
  };

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    // 使用智能旋轉邏輯（包含牆踢）
    const rotated = rotatePieceWithWallKick(currentPiece, board);
    if (rotated) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
      // 播放旋轉音效
      audioManager.playSound('rotate');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 從最左邊開始測試，找到最左邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = 0; testX <= currentPiece.x; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
          if (testX === 0) break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
              if (testX === 0) break;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (testX === 0 && foundValidPosition) break;
        }
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 從當前位置向右測試，找到最右邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = currentPiece.x; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          // 如果這個X位置無法放置（無論在什麼高度），就停止搜索
          if (!foundValidPosition) {
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      setShowGameOverDialog(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      setShowGameOverDialog(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused || showStartDialog || showGameOverDialog) return;

    const speedMultiplier = DROP_SPEED_MULTIPLIERS[dropSpeed];
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level, speedMultiplier));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, dropSpeed, showStartDialog, showGameOverDialog, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  // 遊戲結束時清理音效
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gameOver) {
      // 停止遊戲音樂，但保留選單音樂的記錄
      audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
      // 設置選單音樂為下次播放的音樂
      audioManager.lastPlayedMusic = 'menu';
    }
  }, [gameOver]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ← 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* 開始遊戲對話框 */}
      {showStartDialog && (
        <StartGameDialog 
          onStart={handleStartGame}
          onBack={onBack}
        />
      )}
      
      {/* 遊戲結束對話框 */}
      {showGameOverDialog && (
        <GameOverDialog 
          score={score}
          level={level}
          lines={lines}
          onRestart={handleRestartGame}
          onBack={handleBackToMenu}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;

```

現在我需要檢查GameInfo組件的樣式，確保它在右側邊欄中顯示得當：


GameInfo的樣式看起來已經適合放在右側邊欄。現在我需要檢查GamePage的CSS，確保右側邊欄的佈局正確：


讓我檢查game-sidebar的樣式：


右側邊欄的寬度只有120px，這可能不夠顯示GameInfo組件。讓我調整右側邊欄的寬度：


```css
.game-page {
  width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
}

.game-background {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 800"><defs><linearGradient id="hills" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%"><stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:%234CAF50;stop-opacity:1" /><stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:%23388E3C;stop-opacity:1" /><stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:%232E7D32;stop-opacity:1" /></linearGradient></defs><path d="M0,600 Q200,400 400,450 T800,400 T1200,350 L1200,800 L0,800 Z" fill="url(%23hills)"/><path d="M0,700 Q300,500 600,550 T1200,500 L1200,800 L0,800 Z" fill="url(%23hills)" opacity="0.7"/></svg>');
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  opacity: 0.2;
  z-index: 1;
}

.game-container {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 20px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
  border-radius: 15px;
  padding: 20px;
  border: 3px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

.game-sidebar {
  width: 200px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
}

.game-sidebar.right {
  width: 250px;
}

.game-main {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 15px;
}

.game-header {
  display: flex;
  gap: 15px;
  align-items: center;
}

.back-button, .pause-button {
  padding: 10px 20px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: bold;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  color: white;
}

.back-button {
  background: linear-gradient(45deg, #FF6B6B, #FF8E53);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.4);
}

.back-button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.6);
}

.pause-button {
  background: linear-gradient(45deg, #4CAF50, #45a049);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.4);
}

.pause-button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.6);
}

.level-up-message {
  position: absolute;
  top: 60px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: linear-gradient(45deg, #FFD700, #FFA500);
  color: #000;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  font-weight: bold;
  z-index: 10;
  animation: levelUpAnimation 2s ease-in-out;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.5);
  text-shadow: 1px 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

@keyframes levelUpAnimation {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-20px) scale(0.8);
  }
  20% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0) scale(1.1);
  }
  80% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-20px) scale(0.8);
  }
}

.line-clear-message {
  position: absolute;
  top: 100px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: linear-gradient(45deg, #FF6B6B, #FF8E53);
  color: white;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: bold;
  z-index: 10;
  animation: lineClearAnimation 0.5s ease-in-out;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.5);
  text-shadow: 1px 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
}

@keyframes lineClearAnimation {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-10px) scale(0.8);
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0) scale(1.2);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-10px) scale(0.8);
  }
}
```

首先將GameInfo組件從右側移到左側：


```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './GamePage.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT, getLevelSpeed, DROP_SPEED_MULTIPLIERS } from '../utils/gameConstants';
import audioManager from '../utils/audioManager';
import { 
  createEmptyBoard, 
  getRandomPiece, 
  isValidPosition, 
  placePiece, 
  clearLines, 
  calculateScore,
  getGhostPiece,
  rotatePiece,
  rotatePieceWithWallKick
} from '../utils/gameLogic';
import GameBoard from './GameBoard';
import GameInfo from './GameInfo';
import HoldArea from './HoldArea';
import NextPieces from './NextPieces';
import StartGameDialog from './StartGameDialog';
import GameOverDialog from './GameOverDialog';

const GamePage = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(createEmptyBoard());
  const [currentPiece, setCurrentPiece] = useState(null);
  const [nextPieces, setNextPieces] = useState([]);
  const [heldPiece, setHeldPiece] = useState(null);
  const [canHold, setCanHold] = useState(true);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(0);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [gameStarted, setGameStarted] = useState(false);
  const [levelUpMessage, setLevelUpMessage] = useState(null);
  const [pressedKeys, setPressedKeys] = useState(new Set());
  const [clearingLines, setClearingLines] = useState([]);
  const [isClearing, setIsClearing] = useState(false);
  const [lineClearMessage, setLineClearMessage] = useState(null);
  const [currentMusic, setCurrentMusic] = useState(null);
  const [dropSpeed, setDropSpeed] = useState('medium');
  const [showStartDialog, setShowStartDialog] = useState(true);
  const [showGameOverDialog, setShowGameOverDialog] = useState(false);

  // 載入設定
  useEffect(() => {
    const savedDropSpeed = localStorage.getItem('dropSpeed');
    if (savedDropSpeed !== null) {
      setDropSpeed(savedDropSpeed);
    }
  }, []);

  // 根據等級選擇背景音樂
  const selectBackgroundMusic = useCallback((level) => {
    let musicKey;
    if (level >= 5) {
      musicKey = 'game2';
    } else {
      musicKey = 'game1';
    }
    
    if (musicKey !== currentMusic) {
      audioManager.playBackgroundMusic(musicKey);
      setCurrentMusic(musicKey);
    }
  }, [currentMusic]);

  // 初始化遊戲
  const initGame = useCallback(() => {
    const initialPieces = Array(5).fill().map(() => getRandomPiece());
    setNextPieces(initialPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(getRandomPiece());
    setBoard(createEmptyBoard());
    setScore(0);
    setLevel(0);
    setLines(0);
    setGameOver(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setCanHold(true);
    setHeldPiece(null);
    setGameStarted(true);
    setCurrentMusic(null);
    setShowStartDialog(false);
    setShowGameOverDialog(false);
    
    // 開始播放遊戲背景音樂
    selectBackgroundMusic(0);
  }, [selectBackgroundMusic]);

  // 開始遊戲
  const handleStartGame = () => {
    initGame();
  };

  // 重新開始遊戲
  const handleRestartGame = () => {
    initGame();
  };

  // 返回主頁
  const handleBackToMenu = () => {
    setShowGameOverDialog(false);
    onBack();
  };

  // 移動方塊
  const movePiece = useCallback((dx, dy) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (isValidPosition(currentPiece, board, dx, dy)) {
      setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
    } else if (dy > 0) {
      // 方塊無法繼續下降，放置方塊
      placePieceOnBoard();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 旋轉方塊
  const rotateCurrentPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    // 使用智能旋轉邏輯（包含牆踢）
    const rotated = rotatePieceWithWallKick(currentPiece, board);
    if (rotated) {
      setCurrentPiece(rotated);
      // 播放旋轉音效
      audioManager.playSound('rotate');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 移動方塊到最左邊或最右邊
  const moveToEdge = useCallback((direction) => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let bestX = currentPiece.x;
    let bestY = currentPiece.y;
    
    if (direction === 'left') {
      // 從最左邊開始測試，找到最左邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = 0; testX <= currentPiece.x; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
          // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
          if (testX === 0) break;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              // 如果能在最左邊放置，就使用最左邊
              if (testX === 0) break;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (testX === 0 && foundValidPosition) break;
        }
      }
    } else if (direction === 'right') {
      // 從當前位置向右測試，找到最右邊能放置的位置
      for (let testX = currentPiece.x; testX < BOARD_WIDTH; testX++) {
        // 先嘗試在當前高度放置
        if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX }, board)) {
          bestX = testX;
          bestY = currentPiece.y;
        } else {
          // 如果當前高度不能放置，嘗試下降到合適位置
          let foundValidPosition = false;
          for (let testY = currentPiece.y + 1; testY < BOARD_HEIGHT; testY++) {
            if (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, x: testX, y: testY }, board)) {
              bestX = testX;
              bestY = testY;
              foundValidPosition = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          // 如果這個X位置無法放置（無論在什麼高度），就停止搜索
          if (!foundValidPosition) {
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    setCurrentPiece(prev => ({ ...prev, x: bestX, y: bestY }));
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 瞬間下降
  const hardDrop = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    let dropDistance = 0;
    let testY = currentPiece.y;
    
    // 計算下降距離
    while (isValidPosition({ ...currentPiece, y: testY + 1 }, board)) {
      testY++;
      dropDistance++;
    }
    
    // 立即將方塊移動到最終位置並放置
    const finalPiece = { ...currentPiece, y: testY };
    setScore(prev => prev + dropDistance * 2); // 瞬間下降獎勵分數
    
    // 直接放置方塊到最終位置
    const newBoard = placePiece(finalPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
      }, 500);
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
    }
    
    // 生成新方塊 - 直接在這裡實現邏輯，避免依賴問題
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      setShowGameOverDialog(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, gameOver, isPaused, level, lines, nextPieces]);

  // 暫存方塊
  const holdPiece = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece || !canHold || gameOver || isPaused) return;

    if (heldPiece) {
      // 交換當前方塊和暫存方塊
      const newHeldPiece = { ...currentPiece };
      const newCurrentPiece = {
        ...heldPiece,
        x: Math.floor(BOARD_WIDTH / 2) - Math.floor(heldPiece.shape[0].length / 2),
        y: 0
      };
      setCurrentPiece(newCurrentPiece);
      setHeldPiece(newHeldPiece);
    } else {
      // 暫存當前方塊，生成新方塊
      setHeldPiece({ ...currentPiece });
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
    setCanHold(false);
  }, [currentPiece, heldPiece, canHold, gameOver, isPaused]);

  // 生成新方塊
  const spawnNewPiece = useCallback(() => {
    const newPiece = nextPieces[0];
    const newNextPieces = [...nextPieces.slice(1), getRandomPiece()];
    
    setNextPieces(newNextPieces);
    setCurrentPiece(newPiece);
    setCanHold(true);

    // 檢查遊戲結束
    if (!isValidPosition(newPiece, board)) {
      setGameOver(true);
      setShowGameOverDialog(true);
      // 播放遊戲結束音效
      audioManager.playSound('gameOver');
    }
  }, [nextPieces, board]);

  // 放置方塊到遊戲板
  const placePieceOnBoard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentPiece) return;

    const newBoard = placePiece(currentPiece, board);
    const { board: clearedBoard, linesCleared, linesToClear } = clearLines(newBoard);
    
    if (linesCleared > 0) {
      // 顯示消除行的特效
      setClearingLines(linesToClear);
      setIsClearing(true);
      
      // 播放消除行音效
      audioManager.playSound('lineClear');
      
      // 顯示消除行提示
      const clearMessages = {
        1: 'Single!',
        2: 'Double!',
        3: 'Triple!',
        4: 'Tetris!'
      };
      setLineClearMessage(clearMessages[linesCleared] || `${linesCleared} Lines!`);
      
      // 延遲清除行，讓特效顯示
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBoard(clearedBoard);
        setIsClearing(false);
        setClearingLines([]);
        setLineClearMessage(null);
        
        const newScore = calculateScore(linesCleared, level);
        setScore(prev => prev + newScore);
        setLines(prev => prev + linesCleared);
        
        // 更新等級
        const newLevel = Math.floor((lines + linesCleared) / 10);
        if (newLevel > level) {
          setLevel(newLevel);
          // 根據新等級切換背景音樂
          selectBackgroundMusic(newLevel);
          // 播放等級提升音效
          audioManager.playSound('levelUp');
          // 顯示等級升等提示
          setLevelUpMessage(`等級提升! ${level} → ${newLevel}`);
          setTimeout(() => setLevelUpMessage(null), 2000);
        }
        
        spawnNewPiece();
      }, 500); // 特效持續500ms
    } else {
      setBoard(clearedBoard);
      spawnNewPiece();
    }
  }, [currentPiece, board, level, lines, spawnNewPiece]);

  // 遊戲循環
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver || isPaused || showStartDialog || showGameOverDialog) return;

    const speedMultiplier = DROP_SPEED_MULTIPLIERS[dropSpeed];
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      movePiece(0, 1);
    }, getLevelSpeed(level, speedMultiplier));

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gameStarted, gameOver, isPaused, level, dropSpeed, showStartDialog, showGameOverDialog, movePiece]);

  // 鍵盤控制
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (!gameStarted) return;

      const key = e.key;
      setPressedKeys(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));

      switch (key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住左鍵，直接移動到最左邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            moveToEdge('left');
          } else {
            movePiece(-1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          e.preventDefault();
          // 如果已經按住右鍵，直接移動到最右邊
          if (pressedKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            moveToEdge('right');
          } else {
            movePiece(1, 0);
          }
          break;
        case 'ArrowDown':
          e.preventDefault();
          movePiece(0, 1);
          break;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          e.preventDefault();
          rotateCurrentPiece();
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          hardDrop();
          break;
        case 'Shift':
          e.preventDefault();
          holdPiece();
          break;
        case 'Escape':
          e.preventDefault();
          setIsPaused(prev => !prev);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    };

    const handleKeyUp = (e) => {
      setPressedKeys(prev => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(e.key);
        return newSet;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, [gameStarted, movePiece, rotateCurrentPiece, hardDrop, holdPiece, moveToEdge, pressedKeys]);

  // 遊戲結束時清理音效
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gameOver) {
      // 停止遊戲音樂，但保留選單音樂的記錄
      audioManager.stopBackgroundMusic();
      // 設置選單音樂為下次播放的音樂
      audioManager.lastPlayedMusic = 'menu';
    }
  }, [gameOver]);

  return (
    <div className="game-page">
      <div className="game-background"></div>
      
      <div className="game-container">
        <div className="game-sidebar left">
          <HoldArea heldPiece={heldPiece} />
          <GameInfo 
            score={score} 
            level={level} 
            lines={lines}
            gameOver={gameOver}
            isPaused={isPaused}
            gameStarted={gameStarted}
            onStart={initGame}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-main">
          <div className="game-header">
            <button className="back-button" onClick={onBack}>
              ↩ 返回主頁
            </button>
            <button className="pause-button" onClick={() => setIsPaused(!isPaused)}>
              {isPaused ? '繼續 (ESC)' : '暫停 (ESC)'}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {levelUpMessage && (
            <div className="level-up-message">
              {levelUpMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          {lineClearMessage && (
            <div className="line-clear-message">
              {lineClearMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <GameBoard 
            board={board} 
            currentPiece={currentPiece}
            ghostPiece={currentPiece ? getGhostPiece(currentPiece, board) : null}
            clearingLines={clearingLines}
            isClearing={isClearing}
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="game-sidebar right">
          <NextPieces pieces={nextPieces.slice(0, 5)} />
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* 開始遊戲對話框 */}
      {showStartDialog && (
        <StartGameDialog 
          onStart={handleStartGame}
          onBack={onBack}
        />
      )}
      
      {/* 遊戲結束對話框 */}
      {showGameOverDialog && (
        <GameOverDialog 
          score={score}
          level={level}
          lines={lines}
          onRestart={handleRestartGame}
          onBack={handleBackToMenu}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default GamePage;

```

我看到鬼影方塊的邏輯在第19-20行。現在我來修改鬼影方塊的顏色為灰色：


```javascript
import React from 'react';
import './GameBoard.css';
import { BOARD_WIDTH, BOARD_HEIGHT } from '../utils/gameConstants';

const GameBoard = ({ board, currentPiece, ghostPiece, clearingLines, isClearing }) => {
  // 渲染方塊
  const renderPiece = (piece, isGhost = false) => {
    if (!piece) return null;

    return piece.shape.map((row, y) =>
      row.map((cell, x) => {
        if (cell) {
          const style = {
            position: 'absolute',
            left: `${(piece.x + x) * 25}px`,
            top: `${(piece.y + y) * 25}px`,
            width: '23px',
            height: '23px',
            backgroundColor: isGhost ? 'transparent' : piece.color,
            border: isGhost ? '2px solid #666666' : '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)',
            borderRadius: '2px',
            boxShadow: isGhost ? 'none' : 'inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
            zIndex: isGhost ? 1 : 2
          };
          return <div key={`${x}-${y}`} style={style} />;
        }
        return null;
      })
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="game-board">
      <div className="board-grid">
        {board.map((row, y) =>
          row.map((cell, x) => {
            const isClearingLine = clearingLines.includes(y);
            return (
              <div
                key={`${x}-${y}`}
                className={`grid-cell ${isClearingLine ? 'clearing-line' : ''}`}
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: cell || 'transparent',
                  border: cell ? '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)' : '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                  boxShadow: cell ? 'inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)' : 'none'
                }}
              />
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>
      
      {/* 鬼影方塊 */}
      {ghostPiece && !isClearing && renderPiece(ghostPiece, true)}
      
      {/* 當前方塊 */}
      {currentPiece && !isClearing && renderPiece(currentPiece, false)}
      
      {/* 消除行特效覆蓋層 */}
      {isClearing && clearingLines.map(lineY => (
        <div
          key={`clearing-${lineY}`}
          className="clearing-effect"
          style={{
            top: `${lineY * 25}px`,
            height: '25px'
          }}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

export default GameBoard;
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import './MusicToggle.css';
import audioManager from '../utils/audioManager';

const MusicToggle = () => {
  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(audioManager.getMuted());
  const [volume, setVolume] = useState(Math.round(audioManager.getVolume() * 100));
  const [showSlider, setShowSlider] = useState(false);
  const containerRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    // 從localStorage載入音量設置
    const savedMusicVolume = localStorage.getItem('musicVolume');
    if (savedMusicVolume !== null) {
      const savedVolume = parseInt(savedMusicVolume);
      setVolume(savedVolume);
      audioManager.setVolume(savedVolume / 100);
    }
    setIsMuted(audioManager.getMuted());
  }, []);

  // 點擊外部關閉滑桿
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setShowSlider(false);
      }
    };

    if (showSlider) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    }

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, [showSlider]);

  const handleVolumeChange = (newVolume) => {
    const volumeValue = parseInt(newVolume);
    setVolume(volumeValue);
    audioManager.setVolume(volumeValue / 100);
    
    // 保存到localStorage
    localStorage.setItem('musicVolume', volumeValue.toString());
    
    // 如果音量設為0，則靜音
    if (volumeValue === 0) {
      setIsMuted(true);
    } else {
      setIsMuted(false);
    }
  };

  const handleIconClick = () => {
    // 點擊圖標直接靜音
    audioManager.setVolume(0);
    setVolume(0);
    setIsMuted(true);
    localStorage.setItem('musicVolume', '0');
    setShowSlider(false);
  };

  const getVolumeIcon = () => {
    if (isMuted || volume === 0) return '🔇';
    if (volume < 30) return '🔈';
    if (volume < 70) return '🔉';
    return '🔊';
  };

  return (
    <div 
      ref={containerRef}
      className="music-control-container"
      onMouseEnter={() => setShowSlider(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setShowSlider(false)}
    >
      {/* 音量滑桿 */}
      {showSlider && (
        <div className="volume-slider-container">
          <div className="volume-slider">
            <input
              type="range"
              min="0"
              max="100"
              value={volume}
              onChange={(e) => handleVolumeChange(e.target.value)}
              className="volume-input"
            />
            <div className="volume-display">{volume}%</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      
      {/* 音量圖標 */}
      <button 
        className={`music-toggle ${isMuted ? 'muted' : ''}`}
        onClick={handleIconClick}
        title={isMuted ? '點擊靜音' : '點擊靜音 | 滑鼠懸停調整音量'}
      >
        {getVolumeIcon()}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MusicToggle;
```

```javascript
import React from 'react';
import './GameBoard.css';

const GameBoard = ({ board, currentPiece, ghostPiece, clearingLines, isClearing }) => {
  // 渲染方塊
  const renderPiece = (piece, isGhost = false) => {
    if (!piece) return null;

    return piece.shape.map((row, y) =>
      row.map((cell, x) => {
        if (cell) {
          const style = {
            position: 'absolute',
            left: `${(piece.x + x) * 25}px`,
            top: `${(piece.y + y) * 25}px`,
            width: '23px',
            height: '23px',
            backgroundColor: isGhost ? 'transparent' : piece.color,
            border: isGhost ? '2px solid #666666' : '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)',
            borderRadius: '2px',
            boxShadow: isGhost ? 'none' : 'inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
            zIndex: isGhost ? 1 : 2
          };
          return <div key={`${x}-${y}`} style={style} />;
        }
        return null;
      })
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="game-board">
      <div className="board-grid">
        {board.map((row, y) =>
          row.map((cell, x) => {
            const isClearingLine = clearingLines.includes(y);
            return (
              <div
                key={`${x}-${y}`}
                className={`grid-cell ${isClearingLine ? 'clearing-line' : ''}`}
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: cell || 'transparent',
                  border: cell ? '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)' : '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                  boxShadow: cell ? 'inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)' : 'none'
                }}
              />
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>
      
      {/* 鬼影方塊 */}
      {ghostPiece && !isClearing && renderPiece(ghostPiece, true)}
      
      {/* 當前方塊 */}
      {currentPiece && !isClearing && renderPiece(currentPiece, false)}
      
      {/* 消除行特效覆蓋層 */}
      {isClearing && clearingLines.map(lineY => (
        <div
          key={`clearing-${lineY}`}
          className="clearing-effect"
          style={{
            top: `${lineY * 25}px`,
            height: '25px'
          }}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

export default GameBoard;
```
